sa: तमापतन्तं धूम्राक्षो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। विनर्दमानः सहसा हनूमन्तमभिद्रवत्॥
en: As Hanumān was descending, the powerful Dhūmrākşa, upraising a mace and giving out a shout, made towards him speedily.

sa: गृधैरनुगताश्चास्य वमन्तो ज्वलनं मुखैः। प्रणेदुर्मुखमीक्षन्त्यः संरब्धमशिवं शिवाः॥
en: The jackals followed by vultures, vomiting forth fire and casting their looks at him, began to emit inauspicious cries.

sa: पताकालंकृतं दीप्तं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषितम्। रथं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा समारोहच्चमूपतिः॥
en: Then going round his flaming vehicle, adorn with pennons and garnished with gold, the king* ascended the same. *Vajradanstra.

sa: प्रियमाख्यामि ते देवि भूयश्च त्वां सभाजये। तव प्रभावाद्धर्मज्ञे महानरामेण संयुगे॥ लब्धोऽयं विजयः सीते स्वस्था भव गतज्वरा। रावणश्च हतः शत्रुर्लङ्का चैव वशीकृता॥
en: I do relate to you this pleasant news, O worshipped dame; I do again delight you; it is by your grace, O you conversant with piety, O Sītā, victory has been gained, Do you be consoled and relieved of your anxiety. The enemy Rāvana has been slain and the city of Larikā has been brought under submission.

sa: ते नगानगसंकाशाः शाखामृगगणर्षभाः। बभञ्जः पादपांस्तत्र प्रचकर्षुश्च सागरम्॥
en: Themselves resembling mountains, the foremost of the monkeys began to break down trees and draw them towards the Ocean.

sa: त्वयेदं महदारब्धं कार्यमप्रतिचिन्तितम्। दिष्ट्या त्वां नावधीद्रामो विषमिश्रमिवामिषम्॥
en: By luck it is that Rāma has not yet slain you, who has done this tremendous thing, with poison.

sa: अथवा कपिनैकेन कृतं नः कदनं महत्॥ दुर्जेयाः कार्यगतयो ब्रूत यस्य यथामति। मानुषानो भयं नास्ति तथापि तु विमृश्यताम्॥
en: On the other hand, a single monkey has troubled us grievously. Hard it is therefore to understand the course of events. Do you act, each as he thinks proper, And although no fear come from mortals, yet you should deliberate (as to what you should do).

sa: विकृता विकृताकाराः क्रूराः क्रूरकचेक्षणाः। इच्छामि विविधैर्घातैर्हन्तुमेताः सुदारुणाः॥
en: I desire to slay all these dreadful crooked, ugly she-demons having fearful eyes, meting out to them various punishment.

sa: निर्मलेन सुधौतेन खङ्गेनास्य महच्छिरः। जघान वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य वालिसूनुर्महाबलः॥
en: And (at length) with his stainless and sharpened sword, Vali's son, endued with exceeding strength severed Vajradaństra's huge head.

sa: इदं चिरगृहीतत्वाद्वसनं क्लिष्टवत्तरम्। तथाप्यनूनं तद्वर्णं तथा श्रीमद्यथेतरत्॥
en: Her cloth has been shattered by constant use but her grace has not been rendered worse than its colour.

sa: सुवर्णपुजैर्नाराचैर्बलवन्तौ कृतव्रणौ। प्रसुनुवाते रुधिरं कीर्तिमन्तौ जये धृतौ॥
en: And pierced with närâchas knobbed with gold, those-powerful and illustrious (warriors) with their hearts set on celebrity, bled profusely.

sa: श्रुत्वा त्रिशिरसो वाक्यं देवान्तकनरान्तकौ। अतिकायश्च तेजस्वी बभूवुयुद्धहर्षिताः॥
en: Hearing the speech of Triģiras, Devāntaka, and Narāntaka, and the energetic Atikāya also, were wrought up with martial enthusiam.

sa: विध्वंसयन्तं तरसा दृष्ट्वैव पवनात्मजम्। राक्षसानां सहस्राणि हनूमन्तमवाकिरन्॥
en: Finding the Wind-god's son, Hanumān, suddenly spreading devastation among the Rāks asas by thousands, (they) showered (shafts) on him.

sa: ततो भेरीमृदङ्गानां पणवानां च निःस्वनः। शङ्खनेमिस्वनोन्मिश्रः संबभूवाद्भुतोपमः॥
en: The sounds of kettle-drums and Mşdangas and Panavas, mingled with those of conchs and carwheels, were wonderful (to hear).

sa: पीड्यमानास्तु बलिना वरदानेन रक्षसा। दीप्तैस्तपोभिर्विबुधाः पितामहपूजयन् ॥
en: The celestials being thus oppressed by Ravana, who had obtained the boon, worshipped the great Patriachs with sever austerities.

sa: तुमुलं त्रासजननं भीमं भीमप्रतिस्वनम्। तद्वर्षमभवद्युद्धे नैकशस्त्रमयं महत्॥
en: That downpour of various weapons became huge and terrible in the conflict creating terror and making a dreadful noise.

sa: स ददर्श महातेजा रावणः कपिसत्तमम्। रक्षोभिर्विकृताकारैः कृष्यमाणमितस्ततः॥
en: And the exceedingly energetic Rāvana saw that foremost of monkeys dragged hither and thither by Rākṣasas of frightful forms.

sa: विबुध्य तु महाभागो राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्। स्रस्तमाल्याम्बरधरो वैदेहीमन्वचिन्तयत्॥
en: Awaking, that great and powerful lord of Rākşasas, having his cloth and garlands loosened, began to think of Vaidehi.

sa: प्रापणे चास्य मन्त्रस्य निवृत्ताः सर्वमन्त्रिणः। अवश्यं च मया वाच्यं यदृष्टमथवा श्रुतम्।। संविधाय यथान्यायं तद्भवान्कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: All the counsellors have refrained from tendering this counsel to you; but surely I must tell you what I have seen or heard; and adopting proper measures, it behove you to act so.* *In accordance with my suggestion.

sa: स तैः प्रवृद्धैः परिभय॑मानो वनस्य गोप्ता हरिवृद्धवीरः। चकार भूयो मतिमुग्रतेजा वनस्य रक्षां प्रति वानरेभ्यः॥
en: And that heroic, elderly monkey, the guard of the garden, was in return remonstrated with by them who were greatly intoxicated. Thereat the highly spirited monkey again made up his mind to protect the garden from their devastations.

sa: अब्रवीचां तु शोकाता निरानन्द तपस्विनीम्। दृष्ट्वा रथस्थितां दीनां राक्षसेन्द्रसुतश्रिताम् ॥ किं समर्थितमस्येति चिन्तयन्स महाकपिः। सह तैर्वानरश्रेष्ठैरभ्यधावत रावणिम्॥
en: Seeing her on the car, innocent, poor, deprived of joy and brought under the influence of the son of the lord Rākşasas that great monkey thought within himself— 'What must be the intention of Indrajit?' and accompanied by heroic monkeys advanced towards the son of Ravana.

sa: संत्रस्तहृदयाः सर्वे प्राकारादवरुह्यते। विवर्णा राक्षसा घोरा राक्षसेन्द्रमुपस्थिताः॥
en: Thereat, with their hearts wrought up, grimvisaged Rākşasas descending from the wall appeared before the Rākşasa-lord with pale faces.

sa: सा महार्णवमासाद्य हृष्टा वानरवाहिनी। वायुवेगसमाधूतं पश्यमाना महार्णवम्॥
en: And reaching the shore of the vastly deep, that monkey host, delighted, beheld the ocean moved by the Wind.

sa: शलभा इव केदारं मशका इव पावकम्। यथामृतघटं दंशा मकरा इव चार्णवम्॥ तथा रक्षोधनुर्मुक्ता वज्रानिलमनोजवाः। हरिं विशन्ति स्म शरा लोका इव विपर्यये।४।।
en: As locusts (flood) a field, knots (throng) about a flame, gad-flies (cluster) around a pot of honey, or makaras (range) in the sea, so the shafts shot by the bows of the Rākṣasa, having (the energy of) the thunder-bolt and endowed with (the velocity of) the wind or thought, pierce Hari as if at the universal dissolution.

sa: इतीव स महाबाहुः सीताहरणकर्शितः। रामः सागरमासाद्य वासमाज्ञापयत्तदा॥
en: And reaching the shores of the ocean, the large-armed Rāma, stricken with grief for Sītā, ordered their encampment, saying.

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महापार्योऽब्रवीद्वचः। बलाध्यक्षान्स्थितांस्तत्र बलं संत्वर्यतामिति॥
en: Hearing his words Mahāpārsva addressed the leaders of the army who were near him, saying, "Get your soldiers ready."

sa: योजनानां शतं श्रीमांस्ती।त्युत्तमविक्रमः। अनिःश्वसन् कपिस्तत्र न ग्लानिमधिगच्छति॥
en: Having cleared an hundred Yoyanas, that monkey gifted with first-rate prowess, did not heave sighs or feel any fatigue.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहु रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः। संधाय बाणमस्त्रेण चमूपतिमताडयत्॥
en: Having said this, the mighty-armed Ravanalord of the Rākşasas-fixing his shaft on his bow, shot it at the general.

sa: परिष्वज्य च सुग्रीवं लक्ष्मणेनाभिवादितः॥ पूज्यमानो हरिगणैराजगाम बलालयम्।
en: Embracing Sugrīva, bowed to by Lakşmaņa and worshipped by the monkey he repaired to the camp of his soldiers.

sa: सीतापि देवकार्याणि कृत्वा पौर्वाहिणकानि वै। श्वश्रूणामकरोत्पूजां सर्वासामविशेषतः॥
en: Sītā, too, having performed all religious ceremonies of morning, first in all, attended to the service of her mother-in-law.

sa: रामस्तु व्यथितं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रं महाहवे। व्यादिदेश हरिश्रेष्ठाञ्जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्ततः॥
en: Rama, hearing that Vali's son had come to grief in terrific fight, directed the principal monkeys, headed by Jambavan.

sa: कुम्भकर्णः प्रमत्तस्तु महर्षीन्धर्मवत्सलान्। त्रैलोक्ये नित्यासंतुष्टो भक्षयन्विचचार ह॥
en: Kumbhakarma, maddened to the height, devouring mighty-saints devoted to religion, constantly ranged the triune world in a dissatisfied spirit.

sa: जयद्रथो भीमरथः सम्पातिऋषभो जयः॥ भूमिजयो वृषक्राधो नैषधश्च महाबलः। वृता बलेन महता ब्रह्मलोकपुरस्कृताः॥ व्यूहस्योरसि ते राजन् स्थिता युद्धविशारदाः।
en: Jayadratha, Bhimaratha, Sampati, the Rishabha, the Jaya, Bhuminjaya, Vrishakratha and the ruler of the Nishadhas of great prowess. O monarch, these, surrounded by mighty hosts, accomplished in fighting and keeping the region of Brahma before their view, stationed their selves in the bosom of that array.

sa: शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च विक्रान्ताश्च महारथाः। विनिघ्नन्तश्च भीमेन संरब्धेनाभिचोदिताः॥
en: Those mighty car-warriors, brave, endued with strength and prowess, are again urged on to battle, by the wrathful Bhima.

sa: तावुभौ शरचित्राङ्गौ रुधिरेण समुक्षितौ। बभूवतुर्महात्मानौ पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ॥
en: Then both those high-souled warriors, mangled with arrow-wounds and steeped in blood, appeared like two Kinshukas covered with blossom,

sa: कालिङ्गमभिदुद्राव तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्। ततः श्रुतायुर्बलवान् भीमाय निशिताशरान्॥ प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम्। स कार्मुकवरोत्सृष्टैर्नवभिर्निशितैः शरैः॥ समाहतो महाराज कालिङ्गेन महात्मना। संचुक्रुशे भृशं भीमो दण्डाहत इवोरगः॥
en: Then he rushed towards the Kalinga king, shouting “Wait” “Wait”. Then the greatly powerful Shrutayu, in great anger, shot at Bhima many sharp arrows and thus displayed his great lightness of hands. O king, thus wounded by those nine sharp arrows shot by the Kalinga king from his excellent bow, that great warrior Bhima blazed up in anger like a snake struck with a rod.

sa: अन्वयातां तदा मध्ये वासुदेवधनंजयौ। बभूवुरतिसंरब्धाः कृतप्रहरणा नराः॥
en: And in this middle division followed Vasudeva and Dhananjaya. And these were men well-accomplished in arms, burning with anger.

sa: नग्नस्य नायमानस्य या च वन्ध्यातिथेर्गतिः। उत्कोचिनां मृषोक्तीनां वञ्चकानां च या गतिः॥ आत्मापहारिणां या च या च मिथ्याभिशंसिनाम्। भृत्यैः संदिश्यमानानां पुत्रदाराश्रितैस्तथा॥ असंविभज्य क्षुद्राणां या गतिर्मिष्टमश्नताम्। तां गच्छेयं गति घोरां न चेद्धन्यां जयद्रथम्॥
en: That end that overtakes him who bathes naked in water or him who does not hospitably entertain a guest; that and that overtakes them who accept bribes, speak falsehoods and deceive and cheat men; that end that overtakes them who offend against their own souls or who falsely utter praises, that end ihat overtakes low wretches who eat sweetmeats before servants, and wives and dependents without giving them a share of them, may that end also overtake me if I do not slay Jayadratha.

sa: तथैव शरवर्षेण उलूकं समविद्ध्यता उलूकश्चापि तं बाणैर्निशितैर्लोमवाहिभिः॥
en: He wounded Uluka with a shower of arrows and Uluka too wounded him with sharp arrows with excellent wings.

sa: ते मनः क्रूरमाधाय समभित्यक्तजीविताः। पाण्डवानभ्यवर्तन्त सर्व एवोच्छ्रितध्वजाः॥
en: All the Kuru warriors, reckless of their lives, with cruel intentions, rushed upon the Pandavas with their standards upraised.

sa: तैः सम्प्रयुक्तैः स महारथाग्न्यै र्गङ्गासुतः समरे चित्रयोधी। न विव्यथे शान्तनवो महात्मा समागतैः पाण्डुसुतैः समस्तैः॥
en: Though assailed in battle by all the sons of Pandu, all mighty car-warriors united in a body, the son of Shantanu begotten upon Ganga, that high-souled warrior versed in all modes of warfare, flinched not in the least.

sa: मेरुरुत्तममध्यानामधमानां च पक्षिणाम्। अविशेषकरो यस्मात् तस्मादेनं त्यजाम्यहम्॥
en: "I shall go away from this mountain, because there is no difference there between good, indifferent and bad birds".

sa: कलिङ्गप्रभवां चैव मांसशोणितकर्दमाम्। रुधिरस्यन्दिनीं तत्र भीमः प्रावर्तयन्नदीम्॥
en: Bhima caused a river of blood to flow, it was made of the flesh and blood of the Kalingas.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसः सुमहाबलः। त्वरमाणस्ततो मायां प्रयोक्तुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: That Rakshasa (Alambusha) endued with great strength, beholding Iravat make towards himself, speedily began to put forth his illusions.

sa: मृत्युस्त्वेषां व्याधयस्तत्प्रसूता व्याधी रोगो रुज्यते येन जन्तुः। सर्वेषां च प्राणिनां प्रायणान्ते तस्माच्छोकं मा कृथा निष्फलं त्व त्वम्॥
en: Death is the lot of all living creatures. Maladies originate out of living creatures. Maladies are the abnormal conditions of living beings and they are pained by them. Discase and death fall to the share of all creatures. Therefore do you not indulge in fruitless griet

sa: वैकर्तनं त समरे विराटः प्रत्यवारयत्। सह मत्स्यैर्महावीर्यस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: King Virata, with the highly puissant Matsyas, opposed in battle the of Vikartana. And there raged a wonderful combat.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः। व्यादिदेश महाराज रथिनो रथिनां वरः॥ शिरोऽभूद् दुपदस्तस्य पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः। चक्षुषी सहदेवश्च नकुलश्च महारथः॥
en: Thus spoken to by the son of Pritha (Yudhishthira) that mighty car-warrior Dhrishtadyumna, O sovereign, proclaimed that order among the car-warrior (for forming the Makara array). King Drupada and the Pandava Dhananjaya formed its head, Sahadeva along with the mighty car-warriors Nakula constituted its two eyes.

sa: दैवमेवापरे यज्ञ योगिनः पर्युपासते। ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति॥
en: Some yogis perform the Sacrifice to the Celestial; others (however) offer up (such) Sacrifices in the Sacrifice of Brahma-Fire.

sa: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ मत्ताविव महाद्विपौ॥ व्याघ्राविव सुसंरब्धावन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः।
en: Roaring like two bulls, they rushed against each other like two gigantic mad elephants or like two angry tigers.

sa: यः स्पर्धते रणे नित्यं जामदग्न्यं महाबलम्। अजितं जामदग्न्येन शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमम्॥ तं हतं समरे भीष्मं महारथकुलोदितम्। संजयाचक्ष्व मे वीरं येन शर्म न विद्महे॥
en: O Sanjaya, he who always considered himself equal to the mighty son of Jamadagni, he whom Jamadagni's son himself could not conquer, he who resembled Indra in prowess, tell me how such a hero, Bhishma, born as he was in the race of Maharathas, was killed in battle. Without knowing all the particulars, I cannot get rest.

sa: हतैर्गजपदात्योधैर्वाजिभिश्च निषूदितैः। स्थैश्च बहुधा भग्नैः समास्तीर्यत मेदिनी॥
en: The earth become strewn over with slain elephants, and mangled foot-soldiers and chargers, and with cars broken into splinters.

sa: सोऽर्जुनप्रमुखे यान्तं पाञ्चालकुलवर्धनः। त्रिभिः शारद्वतं बाणैर्जत्रुदेशे समार्पयत्॥
en: When he was thus going to Arjuna's aid, he struck Somadatta's son on his shoulder joint with three arrows.

sa: प्रावर्तत नदी घोरा शोणितौघतरङ्गिणीः। गोमायुगणसंकीर्णा क्षणेन क्षणदामुखे॥
en: Then in a moment, towards nightfall, a dreadful river surging with billows of flow across the field of battle.

sa: मुहुरुत्पततो दिक्षु धावतश्च यशस्विनः॥ मार्गाश्च चरतश्चित्रं व्यस्मयन्त रणे जनाः। स जघान पदा कांश्चिद् व्याक्षिप्यान्यानपोथयत्॥
en: Often jumping up and frequently rushing on all sides, that greatly powerful hero roved about and filled all the troops with wonder. Some he killed by his legs, some he dragged down and pressed them into the earth,

sa: भीमसेनोऽग्रणीस्तेषां धृष्टद्युम्नश्च वीर्यवान्। नकुलः सहदेवश्च दृष्टकेतुश्च पार्थिवः॥
en: Bhimasena, the greatly powerful Dhrishtadyumna, Nakula and Sahadeva and king Dhrishtaketu become the several leaders of the (Pandava) force.

sa: विराटस्तु सहानीकः सहसेनं जयद्रथम्। वृद्धक्षत्रस्य दायादमाससाद परंतप॥
en: Then, O afflicter of foes, Virata supported by his division confronted Jayadratha with his troops, that heir of Vridhakshatra.

sa: अनिष्टदर्शनं दृष्ट्वा धृष्टद्युम्नमवस्थितम्। क्षणेनैवाभवद् द्रोणो नातिहृष्टमना इव॥
en: Beholding evil omen in the person of Dhrishtadyumna stationed before him, for a while Drona became all but cheerful.

sa: शूराणां युध्यमानानां निघ्नतामितरेतरम्। संग्रामस्तुमुलो राजन् प्रावर्तत सुदारुणः॥
en: Then as the heroes fought on and slew one another, O king, there commenced a pell-mell and awful fight.

sa: उदतिष्ठन्महाराज सर्वं युक्तमशेषतः। सूर्योदये महत् सैन्यं कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥
en: O king, rising at sunrise, the large armies of the Kurus and the Pandavas made all their arrangements complete.

sa: बृहद्बलश्च कौसल्यो जयत्सेनश्च मागधः। तथा रुक्मरथो राजन् पुत्रः शल्यस्य मानितः॥ विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः। बृहत्क्षत्रस्य दायादः सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः॥
en: O king! The names of those chariot holders are-Brihadbala, the king of Kosala, Jayatsena the king of Magadha, Rukinaratha the valorous son of Shalya, Vinda and Anuvinda (the princes of Avanti), Sudakshina, the king of Kamboja and Jayadratha, the king of Sindhu and son of Brihatkshatra.

sa: शलोभूरिश्रवाः शल्य: कौसल्योऽथ बृहद्रथः। एते पश्चादनुगता धार्तराष्ट्रपुरोगमाः॥
en: And Shalya and Brihadratha the monarch of the Kausalya, marched in the rear, led by the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: ततः कलिङ्गाः संनद्धा भीमसेनममर्षणम्। अनीकैर्बहुसाहस्रैः क्षत्रियाः समवारयन्॥
en: Thereupon the Kalinga warriors in great anger met the angry Bhimasena in battle backed by many thousands of combatants.

sa: उदतिष्ठन्महाराज सर्वं युक्तमशेषतः। सूर्योदये महत् सैन्यं कुरुपाण्डवसेनयोः॥
en: O king, rising at sunrise, the large armies of the Kurus and the Pandavas made all their arrangements complete.

sa: एष योत्स्यति संग्रामे पाण्डवांश्च महारथान्॥ सागरोमिसमैर्बाणैः प्लावयन्निव शात्रवान्। भूरिश्रवाः कृतास्त्रश्च तव चापि हितः सुहृत्॥
en: These will fight in the battle with those great car warriors on the Pandavas side covering the enemies with arrows as ways covering the open. Bhurishravas, that master in the use of weapons, is also your will wisher.

sa: खड्गपाणिरदीनात्मा तस्थौ भूमौ सुदंशितः॥ स चचार बहून् मार्गानभितः पातयन् गजान्। अग्निचक्रमिवाविद्धं सर्वतः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥ अश्ववृन्देषु नागेषु रथानीकेषु चाभिभूः। पदातीनां च संघेषु विनिमशोणितोक्षितः॥ श्येनवद् व्यचरद् भीमो रणेऽरिषु बलोत्कटः। छिन्दस्तेषां शरीराणि शिरांसि च महाबलः॥ खड्गेन शितधारेण संयुगे गजयोधिनाम्।
en: Clad in armour, stood on the ground with his sword in his hand. Cutting down many elephants on all sides, he roved about making his way (through the troops of the enemy). He appeared to be like a moving wheel of fire. He slaughtered innumerable horsemen, elephants and car-warriors and foot soldiers. That foremost of men, the mighty Bhima was seen to move about the field with the speed of the hawk, cutting off with his sharp sword the bodies and heads of countless men (on foot) and also of those who were on elephant.

sa: जयत्सेनस्तु समरे भीमं भीमायुधं युधि। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैरष्टभिर्भरतर्षभ।॥
en: O foremost of the Bharatas, then Jayatsena in that battle Bhimasena possessed of terrible weapon, with eight sharp arrows.

sa: पत्तिसङ्घा रणे पत्तीन् भिन्दिपालपरश्वधैः। न्यपातयन्त संहृष्टाः परस्परकृतागसः॥
en: Innumerable foot-soldiers angrily and at the same time cheerfully cut down one another with short arrows and battle axes.

sa: ततः शतसहस्राणि शराणां नतपर्वणाम्। असृजन्नर्जुने राजन् संशप्तकमहारथाः॥
en: Thereat, O monarch, the mighty carwarriors, of the Samshaptaka host showered upon Arjuna hundreds and thousands of straight-jointed shafts.

sa: भद्रेश्वरं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्भृशं विद्ध्वा महायशाः॥ कृपं च नवभिर्बाणैर्भृशं विद्ध्वा समन्ततः। प्राग्ज्योतिषं शतैराजौ राजन् विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Of illustrious fame, having pierced the king of the Madras with three shafts, and having pierced Kripa with nine arrows by all sides and too wounded the ruler of the Pragjyotishas, O king, with hundred shafts in battle.

sa: केकयाश्चाभिमन्युश्च द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः। दशार्णाधिपतिः शूरः क्षत्रदेवश्च मारिष॥
en: The five Kaikeya brothers, Abhimanyu the sons of Draupadi, the heroic, ruler of the Dasharnas, Kshatra, and O sire,

sa: तौ वृषाविव नर्दन्तौ मण्डलानि विचेरतुः। आवर्तितगदाशृङ्गावुभौ शल्यवृकोदरौ॥
en: The both Shalya and Vrikodara, whirling their maces and moving in various orders, began to course in various circles.

sa: ऋते भीष्मं महाबाहुं मां चापि मुनितेजस॥ सम्भ्रमश्च महानासीत् त्रिदशानां विशाम्पते। पतिष्यति स्थाद् भीष्मे सर्वलोकप्रिये तदा॥ इति देवगणानां च वाक्यं श्रुत्वा महातपाः।
en: Save the mighty armed Bhishma and myself through the prowess of the sage (Vyasa). O ruler of men, great was the flurry that was then found among the Gods, As they thought of the fall of Bhishma, that favorite of all the worlds. Then hearing those words of the celestial, that hero of great ascetic wealth, viz.,

sa: त्वयैकेनापराद्धं मे सीतामाहरता बलात्। वधायानपराद्धानामन्येषां तद् भविष्यति॥
en: You alone are guilty of forcibly carrying off Sita; but your guilt will lead many innocent persons to death.

sa: गाण्डीवं स्रुक् तथा चाज्यं वीर्यं पुंसां भविष्यति। ऐन्द्रं पाशुपतं ब्राझं स्थूणाकर्णं च माधव। मन्त्रास्तत्र भविष्यन्ति प्रयुक्ताः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: The Gandiva bow will be the sacrificial ladle and the might of men will constitute the clarified butter to be poured as libation on the fire. The weapons Aindra, Pashupata, Brahma, and Sthunakarna, O Madhava, used by Savyasachi will be the incantations (Mantras) in the sacrifice.

sa: सेयं दानकृता व्युष्टिरनुप्राप्ता सुखं त्वया। तां भुक्ष्व सुकृतैर्लब्धां तपसा द्योतितप्रभः॥ एतत् स्वर्गसुखं विप्र लोका नानाविधास्तथा। गुणाः स्वर्गस्य प्रोक्तास्ते दोषानपि निबोध मे॥
en: You have easily acquired that success by your charities, your effulgence is displayed by virtue of your asceticism. (Now) enjoy that condition which is obtained by your meritorious acts. Such, O Brahmana, is bliss of heaven containing many worlds. Thus have I described to you the blessing of the celestial, region. Now hear some of its disadvantages.

sa: तानवेक्ष्य हतोत्साहानुत्पातानपि चाद्भुतान्। गुरुः शस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठो भारद्वाजोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Seeing them dispirited and many wonderful omens, the preceptor Drona, the foremost of wielders of weapon, Bharadvaja's son, said.

sa: उत्तर उवाच सुवर्णविकृतानिमान्यायुधानि महात्मनाम्। रुचिराणि प्रकाशन्ते पार्थानामाशुकारिणाम्॥
en: Uttara said Truly these golden weapons, belonging to the light handed and noble sons of Pritha, are greatly beautiful.

sa: आपस्तम्ब उवाच यथा वदन्ति शान्तायां दिशि वै मृगपक्षिणः। पार्थिवी च प्रवृत्तिस्ते तथा जीवति सत्यवान्॥
en: Mandyavya said: From the manner in which birds and beasts are sending forth their voices in the still atmosphere and since you have regained your sight making you useful for worldly purposes, it is sure that Satyavana lives.

sa: युद्धं समभवत् तत्र सुसंरब्धं महात्मनोः। द्रोणपाण्डवयो?रं वृत्रवासवयोरिव॥
en: Then there ensued a highly terrific encounter between the high-souled Drona and Arjuna like that between Vritra and Vasava.

sa: अभिवृष्टश्च वर्षेण नानापुष्पसुगन्धिना। परिष्वक्तश्च पुण्येन वायुना पुण्यगन्धिना॥
en: (He went up heaven) amidst the downpour of a shower of sweet scented flow very smell indicated its holiness.

sa: ततः सभा समासाद्य केशवस्यानुयायिनः। सशङ्खर्वेणुनिघोषैर्दिशः सर्वा व्यनादयन्॥
en: The followers of Keshava having arrived at the Assembly-Hall filled all directions with the sound of conches and cymbals.

sa: उत्तर उवाच नोत्सहे कुरुभिर्योद्धं रोमहर्षं हि पश्य मे। बहुप्रवीरमत्युग्रं देवैरपि दुरासदम्॥ प्रतियोद्धं न शक्ष्यामि कुरुसैन्यमनन्तकम्। नाशंसे भारती सेनां प्रवेष्टुं भीमकार्मुकम्॥ रथनागाश्वकलिलां पत्तिध्वजसमाकुलाम्। दृष्ट्वैव हि परानाजौ मनः प्रव्यथतीव मे॥
en: Uttara said I dare not fight with the Kurus: see the hairs of my body have stood erect. I am unable to fight with the vast Kuru army, consisting of many irrepressible heroes and hard to be vanquished even by the celestials. I dare not enter into the army of the Bharatas consisting of the dreadful bowmen, horses, elephants, chariots infantry and flags. My mind is pained at the view of the enemy in the battle-field.

sa: अदृश्यन्तोद्यतान्येव सर्वप्रहरणानि च। नानाबाहुषु कृष्णस्य दीप्यमानानि सर्वशः॥
en: Were seen upraised and all other arms of offence blazing in all directions in the many hands of Krishna.

sa: तां चासीनौ ददृशतुर्भीमसेनयुधिष्ठिरौ। अमृष्यमाणौ कृष्णायाः कीचकेन पराभवन्॥
en: Both Bhimasena and Yudhishthira, who were seated there, beheld with unforgiving attitude, that outrage on Krishna committed by Kichaka.

sa: प्रतियुध्येम समरे सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्। तस्माद् यदत्र कल्याणं लोके सिद्धिरनुष्ठितम्। तत् संविधीयतां शीघ्रं मा वो ह्यर्थोऽभ्यगात् परम्।। न हि पश्यामि संग्रामे कदाचिदपि कौरव। एकान्तसिद्धिं राजेन्द्र सम्प्राप्तश्च धनंजयः॥ सम्प्रवृत्ते तु संग्रामे भावाभावौ जयाजयौ। अवश्यमेकं स्पृशतो दृष्टमेतदसंशयम्॥
en: We shall have to content against, in battle, the foremost of all of all heroes; let such arrangements be made speedily, which are good and approved by the honest so that our properties may not pass into the hands of the enemies. O Kaurava, O emperor, I have never seen a battle in which one party is sure to come off victorious. (Besides) Arjuna has come. When a battle begins there is victory and defeat, prosperity and adversity. Therefore one must have either of the two. I have observed it without doubt.

sa: तिग्मांशुस्तां तेजसा मोहयित्वा योगेनाविश्यात्मसंस्थां चकार। न चैवैनां दूषयामास भानुः संज्ञां लेभे भूय एवाथ बाला॥
en: And that deity of hot rays making her insensible by his energy placed himself within her by his yoga power. But Bhanu did not corrupt her. The girl, then (i.e. when the sun had departed) recovered her senses.

sa: तस्माद् विनिश्चयमिमं शृणुध्वं त्रिदिवौकसः। विष्णोः क्षयमुपागम्य समेत्य च महात्मना। तेन सम्मन्त्र्य वेत्स्यामो वधोपायं दुरात्मनः॥
en: Therefore O you denizens of the heaven, this is certain that by going to the abode of Vishnu and joining with that large-minded one and consulting with him we shall know the means of slaying the vicious one.

sa: श्रीमान् दधिमुखोनाम हरिवृद्धोऽतिवीर्यवान्। प्रचकर्ष महासैन्यं हरीणां भीमतेजसाम्॥
en: The highly-powerful and illustrious old monkey, Dadhimukha by name, gathered a great army of monkeys endued with terrible prowess.

sa: किं कार्यमिति वै राजन् विचिन्त्य भयमोहिताः। जग्मुः सर्वे महात्मानं मनोभिर्विष्णुमव्ययम्। उपविष्टा मन्दराग्नेये सर्वे वृत्रवधेप्सवः॥
en: Filled with dread they thought, O king, on what could best be done. Seated at the summit of Mandara, they all desirous of the destruction of Vritra, went in imagination of Vishnu, who was never to be destroyed.

sa: युधिष्ठिरो धर्ममयो महाद्रुमः स्कन्धोऽर्जुनो भीमसेनोऽस्य शाखाः। माद्रीपुत्रौ पुष्पफले समृद्धे मूलं त्वहं ब्रह्म च ब्राह्मणाश्च।।
en: Yudhishthira is a big tree full of virtue, Arjuna the trunk and Bhimasena its branch. The two sons of Madri represent the numerous fruits and flowers while myself and the Supreme Being and the Brahmanas ate the roots.

sa: पार्थं च सुमहाबाहुर्महावेगैर्महारथः। विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैर्मेघो वृष्ट्येव पर्वतम्॥
en: That mighty car-warrior of large arms wounded Partha with sharpened arrows, as the clouds discharge showers on a mountain.

sa: त्वयि सम्प्रतिपत्स्यन्ते धर्मात्मा सत्यवागिति। तस्मिश्चाधिगमिष्यन्ति यथा लोभादवर्तत।॥
en: Will know you to be virtuous shouted and truthful of speech and will know how avariciously inclined he is.

sa: आच्छादयित्वा दूतांस्तान्मन्त्रिणं सोऽभ्यचोदयत्।।२२ राजमार्गाः क्रियन्तां मे पताकाभिरलंकृताः।
en: Then having covered the messengers with presents, he said to the ministers "Let my highway be decorated with flags."

sa: युगपद् दिक्षु सर्वासु सर्वतोऽस्त्राण्यदर्शयत्॥ एकच्छायमिवाकाशं बाणैश्चक्रे समन्ततः।
en: Displayed his weapons simultaneously in all the quarters. He converted the sky, with his arrows, into one (expansive) shade.

sa: परिगृह्य शतघ्नीश्च सचक्राः सहुडोपलाः। चिक्षिपुर्भुजवेगेन लङ्कामध्ये महास्वनाः॥
en: And seizing the Shataghnis together with discs, clubs and stones, they threw them violently into Lanka uttering load yells.

sa: कृतप्रज्ञो वीतलोभो निरहंकार आत्मवान्॥ दान्तः क्षान्तो मृदुः सौम्यः प्रजाः पालय पार्थिवा मा स्म भूयः क्षिपे: कंचिदविदित्वा बलाबलम्॥
en: Acquiring wisdom, being beyond the reach of covetousness, without vanity, acquiring mastery over self, restraining your desires, endued with forgiveness, humility and being peaceful protect your subjects, O ruler of the carth and do not again insult any body with out knowing his strength and weakness.

sa: केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च सर्वे लोहितकध्वजाः। अक्षौहिणीपरिवृताः पाण्डवानभिसंश्रिताः॥
en: The five brothers of Kaikeya, all having red flags, surrounded by an Akshauhini, have joined the sons of Pandu.

sa: लम्वा हि संज्ञां तु कुरुप्रवीराः पार्थं निरीक्ष्याथ सुरेन्द्रकल्पम्। रणे विमुक्तं स्थितमेकमाजौ स धार्तराष्ट्रस्त्वरितं बभाषे॥
en: The warriors fighting for Kauravas got conscious soon and saw Arjuna standing lonely outside the circle of chariots. He seemed valorous like Indra, the king of gods. Having seen him alone, Duryodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra enquired immediately.

sa: त्वरमाणः शरानस्यन् पाण्डवः प्रबभौ रणे। मध्यंदिनगतोऽर्चिष्माञ्छरदीव दिवाकरः॥
en: Shooting speedily his arrows, the son of Pandu looked in battle like the blazing mid-day sun of the autumn.

sa: इत्येवं परिभर्त्सन्तीस्त्रास्यमाना पुनः पुनः। भर्तृशोकसमाविष्टा निःश्वस्येदमुवाच ताः॥
en: Thus repeatedly threatened and censured, Sita, afflicted with grief for her husband, replied to them with a deep sigh.

sa: ततोऽनुपेतुर्बहवो राधेयस्य पदानुगाः। तांश्च गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तैः प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Then the heroes who followed Karna all attacked Arjunat who killed them with arrows shot from his Gandiva bow.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच सम्यगुक्तं हि कर्णेन तच्छ्रुतं कौरव त्वया। मया हृतां श्रियं स्फीतां तां मोहादपहाय किम्॥ त्वमल्पबुद्ध्या नृपते प्राणानुत्स्रष्टुमर्हसि। अथवाप्यवगच्छामि न वृद्धाः सेवितास्त्वया।॥
en: Shakuni said: O descendant of Kuru, you have heard that Karna has said. His words are indeed full of wisdom. O king, why should you foolishly throw away the great prosperity that I won for you by abandoning your life today through mere silliness? It appears to me today that you never waited upon (wise) old men.

sa: तत्र भोजकटं नाम कृतं नगरमुत्तमम्। तेनं प्रभूतगजवाजिना॥
en: There he built an excellent city called Bhojakata furnished with a large army and plenty of elephants and horses.

sa: वयं चार्धन सैन्यस्य प्रतियोत्स्याम पाण्डवम्। अहं द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च अश्वत्थामा कृपस्तथा। प्रतियोत्स्याम बीभत्सुमागतं कृतनिश्चयम्॥ मत्स्यं वा पुनरायातमागतं वा शतक्रतुम्। अहमावारयिष्यामि वेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: With half the army we shall fight with Arjuna. Myself, Drona, Karna, the son of Drona, as well as Sharadvata's son, Shall firmly fight with Arjuna or the king of Matsya if he has come back or even with the performer of hundred sacrifices. I shall face them like the bank (obstructing the motion of the) ocean.

sa: सोऽयं विधिर्विहितः कर्मणैव संवर्तते संजय तत्र कर्मी तत्र योऽन्यत् कर्मणः साधु मन्येन्मोघं तस्यालपितं दुर्बलस्य॥
en: Therefore it has been ordained by the creator that through work results, O Sanjaya, work. Therefore the opinion that anything other than work is good, is nothing but the uttering of a fool and of a weak man.

sa: यम उवाच स्तथा त्वया वाक्यमिदं समीरितम्। विना पुनः सत्यवतोऽस्य जीवितं वरं वृणीष्वेह शुभे यदिच्छसि॥
en: Yama said: The words uttered by you appear (to me) as delicious as water to a thirsty person. (Therefore), O auspicious girl, do you ask again for any other boon that you like than the life of Satyavana.

sa: अव्याहृतं व्याहृताच्छ्रेय आहुः सत्यं वदेद् व्याहृतं तद् द्वितीयम्। प्रियं वदेद् व्याहृतं तत् तृतीयं धर्म वदेद् व्याहृतं तच्चतुर्थम्॥
en: Not to speak at all is better than speaking. Secondly, if you have to speak, tell the truth. Thirdly, if you have to speak the truth, speak what is agreeable; and fourthly, if you have to speak what is agreeable, speak what is conducive to morality.

sa: पुष्पोपहारैरय॑न्तां देवताश्चापि सर्वशः॥ कुमारा योधमुख्याश्च गणिकाश्च स्वलंकृताः।
en: "Let all the gods be adored with presents of flowers. Let the princes, leading warriors, harlots adorned with ornaments."

sa: अमृष्यमाण: सबलो रावणो निर्ययावथ। राक्षसानां बलैघरिः पिशाचानां च संवृतः।५।। युद्धशास्त्रविधानज्ञ उशना इव चापरः। व्यह्य चौशनसं व्यूहं हरीनभ्यवहारयत्॥
en: Unable to brook this, the mighty Ravana, skilled in the art of war like a second Ushana (Shukracharya), marched out, surrounded by his dreadful Rakshasa and Pishacha troops, and drawing up his army in that array known by the name of Ushana attacked all the monkeys.

sa: स पीडितो महाबाहुर्गृहीत्वा रथकूबरम्। गाङ्गेयो युद्धदुर्धर्षस्तस्थौ दीर्घमिवान्तरम्॥
en: Thus assailed, the powerful son of Ganga stood leaning for a long time on the pole of the car.

sa: यच्च दुःखं त्वया प्राप्तं द्यूते वै कृष्णया सह। परुषाणि च वाक्यानि सूतपुत्रकृतानि वै॥ जटासुरात् परिक्लेश: कीचकाच्च महाद्युते। द्रौपद्याधिगतं सर्वं दमयन्त्या यथाऽशुभम्॥ सर्वं दुःखमिदं वीर सुखोदकं भविष्यति। नात्र मन्युस्त्वया कार्यो विधिर्हि बलवत्तरः॥
en: All the troubles you have encountered with Draupadi after the game of dice and the harsh words you have had, to listen to, through the son of Suta and all the miseries endured, o illustrious one, through the Asura named Jata and Kichaka-all these unhappiness endured by Draupadi as (unhappiness was endured) by Damayanti-all this trouble, O hero, will give rise to happiness. Do not think that all this is through you, this is done by the fate which has greater control over matters.

sa: एतादृशं वचः श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः प्रियराघवः॥ पिधाय को सद्वत्तः प्रस्थितो येन राघवः। स रामस्य पदं गृह्य प्रससार धनुर्धरः॥ अवीक्षमाणो बिम्बोष्ठी प्रययौ लक्ष्मणस्तदा।
en: Thus addressed by her, Lakshmana who was devotedly attached to Rama and who possessed a noble character, shutting up his ears (with his hands) and armed with bow went out following the foot-prints of Rama. And without casting a single look upon her whose lips resembled a (ripe) Bimba fruit, (he) set out (in search of Rama).

sa: जेष्यामि पृथिवीं राजन् सशैलवनकाननाम्। जिता च पाण्डवैर्भूमिश्चतुर्भिर्बलशालिभिः॥ तामहं ते विजेष्यामि एक एव न संशयः। सम्पश्यतु सुदुर्बुद्धिर्भीष्मः कुरुकुलाधमः॥
en: O king, I shall then conquer the earth adorned with mountains, woods and forests. The earth has been conquered by the four mighty Pandavas. I shall certainly conquer it for you single-handed. Let that wretch of the Kuru race, the exceedingly wicked minded Bhishma see it.

sa: अत्र भूतपतिर्नाम सर्वभूतमहेश्वरः। भूतये सर्वभूतानामचरत् तप उत्तमम्॥
en: Here the great Lord of all creatures, by name Bhutpati, practiced austere asceticism for the good of all creatures.

sa: दर्शयामास भीमस्तु सुशर्माणं नराधिपम्। प्रोवाच पुरुषव्याघ्रो भीममाहवशोभिनम्॥
en: Bhima showed to him the king Susharma. The foremost of men then said to Bhima. beautifying the battle field.

sa: गृहाणेदं महाबाहो विशिष्टमतिदुर्धरम्। अस्त्र ब्रह्मशिरो नाम सप्रयोगनिवर्तनम्॥
en: “O mighty armed, accept this superior and irresistible weapon, named Brahmashira, with its method of hurling and recalling it.

sa: भ्रूणहत्याकृतं चापि पापं जह्यादसंशयम्। इतिहासमिमं श्रुत्वा पुरुषोऽपि सुदारुणः॥ मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो राहुणा चन्द्रमा यथा। जयो नामेतिहासोऽयं श्रोतव्यो विजिगीषुणा॥
en: Sins, even of killing embryo, are destroyed by (reading or hearing) it. Even a greatly sinful man, by hearing this history, escapes from all his sins, like the sun from Rahu. This history is called Jaya (victory); it should be heard by those that desire victory.

sa: अस्मिन्नर्थश्च कामश्च निखिलेनोपदेक्ष्यते। इतिहासे महापुण्ये बुद्धिश्च परिनैष्ठिकी।॥
en: It contains many useful instructions on Artha and Kama. This sacred history makes the heart desire to attain salvation.

sa: त्रयस्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि त्रयस्त्रिंशच्छतानि च। त्रयस्त्रिंशच्च देवानां सृष्टिः संक्षेपलक्षणा॥
en: To cite a brief example, The generation of Devas, was thirty three thousand, thirty three hundred and thirty three.

sa: नैकं पतिं मे भगवान् ददातु। स चाप्येवं वरमित्यब्रवीत् तां देवो हि वेत्ता परमं यदत्र॥
en: As Krishna (Draupadi) had repeatedly asked (in her former life) for five times saying, “Give me a husband," the greatly deity had granted her the boon accordingly. The deity himself knows the right or the wrong of this.

sa: ततो देवो गिरिशो वज्रपाणि विवृत्य नेत्रे कुपितोऽभ्युवाच। दरीमेतां प्रविश त्वं शतक्रतो यन्मां बाल्यादवमंस्थाः पुरस्तात्॥
en: Then looking at the wielder of thunder (Indra) with expanded eyes, the deity Girisha (Shiva), said in anger, "O Shatakratu, (Indra) enter this cave without delay, for out of folly you have insulted me before my very eyes."

sa: कृष्णद्वैपायनाच्चैव प्रसूतिर्वरदानजा। धृतराष्ट्रस्य पाण्डोश्च पाण्डवानां च संभवः॥
en: The births of Dhritarashtra and Pandu, by the blessing of Krishna Dvaipayana and also the birth of the Pandavas,

sa: अर्जुनाच्छ्रुतकीर्तिस्तु शतानीकस्तु नाकुलिः। तथैव सहदेवाच्च श्रुतसेनः प्रतापवान्॥
en: From Arjuna was born Shrutakirti, from Nakula was born Shatanika and from Sahadeva was born the greatly powerful Shrutasena.

sa: ततो राजाब्रवीद्वाक्यं सदस्यैश्चोदितो भृशम्। काममेतद्भवत्वेवं यथास्तीकस्य भाषितम्॥
en: Being again and again urged by his Sadasyas, the king said, “Let it be done as asked by Astika.

sa: युधिष्ठिरात् प्रतिविन्ध्यं सुतसोमं वृकोदरात्। अर्जुनाच्छुतकर्माणं शतानीकं च नाकुलिम्॥ सहदेवाच्छ्रुतसेनमेतान् पञ्च महारथान्। पाञ्चाली सुषुवे वीरानादित्यानदितिर्यथा॥
en: Prativindhya begotten by Yudhishthira, Sutasoma by Vrikodara, Shrutakarmana by Arjuna, Shatanika by Nakula and Shrutasena by Sahadeva; they were all great car-warriors. The Panchala princess gave birth to these five heroes, as Aditi gave birth to the Adityas.

sa: सौतिरुवाच व्याहतुकामे वरदे नृपे द्विजं वरं वृणीष्वेति ततोऽभ्युवाच। होता वाक्यं नातिहष्टान्तरात्मा कर्मण्यस्मिंस्तक्षको नैति तावत्॥
en: Sauti said : The king, being willing to grant a boon to the Brahmana boy, said, "Ask from me a boon.” The Hota, being rather displeased at this, said, "Takshaka has not as yet come to this sacrifice.

sa: ततस्ते राजपुरुषा विचिन्वानास्तमाश्रमम्। तदृशुस्तत्र लीनांस्तांश्चौरांस्तद् द्रव्यमेव च॥
en: Thereupon, the officers of the king, in searching that hermitage, found the thieves with the stolen properties concealed there.

sa: ततः प्रभृति साँश्च यावद्विशत्यगायताम्। ततोऽपराह्णसमये राघवः समभाषत॥ श्रुत्वा विंशतिसाँस्तान्भ्रातरं भ्रातृवत्सलः। अष्टादश सहस्राणि सुवर्णस्य महात्मनो॥
en: Having heard up to twentieth section, Răma, fond of his brother, said to Lakşmaņa in the afternoon, O Kakutstha, do you soon confer upon these two high-souled ones eighteen thousand gold coins and all other-things they wish for.

sa: आपृच्छे त्वां गमिष्यामि शिवमाशंस मे पथि। अविरोधेन धर्मस्य स्मर्तव्योऽस्मि कथान्तरे। अप्रमत्तोत्थिता नित्यमाराधय गुरुं मम॥
en: I ask your leave to go away. Bless me so that good may come to my journey. Remember me in your conversations as one who has not transgressed virtue. Serve my preceptor with readiness and singleness of heart.

sa: एवं धर्मेण धर्मज्ञः कृत्वा कर्मातिमानुषम्। भ्रातुर्विचित्रवीर्यस्य विवाहायोपचक्रमे॥ सत्यवत्या सह मिथः कृत्वा निश्चयमात्मवान्। विवाहं कारयिष्यन्तं भीष्मं काशिपतेः सुता। ज्येष्ठा तासामिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद्धसती तदा॥
en: Bhishma gave to Vichitravirya the maidens who were brought by his prowess. The virtuous (Bhishma), having achieved this extraordinary deed according to kingly custom, began to make preparations for his brother's marriage. Having consulted with Satyavati everything about the wedding was settled by Bhishma; but the eldest daughter of the king of Kashi, softly smiling, spoke thus-

sa: ततो यज्ञो महानासीद्धाश्रमसमीपतः॥ रुद्रश्च परमं तोषमाजगाम महायशाः। अथ यज्ञे समाप्ते तु प्रीतः परमया मुदा ।।१६। उमापतिर्द्विजान्सर्वानुवाच इलसंनिधौ।
en: There upon in the vicinity of Budha's hermitage that mighty sacrifice was celebrated. And by that the Great Rudra lord of Umā, attained to delight and said to the twice-born ones, and others at the end of that sacrifice in the presence of the king Ila.

sa: तेषां संवदतामेव द्विजैः सह महात्मभिः। कर्दमस्तु महातेजास्तदाश्रममुपागमत्।८।।
en: There upon while those high-souled ones were conversing upon this subject, the highly effulgent Kardama arrived at the hermitage.

sa: ततः स वारुणास्त्रेण पूरयित्वा कमण्डलुम्। सममाचार्यपुत्रेण गुरुमभ्येति फाल्गुनः॥ आचार्यपुत्रात् तस्मात् तु विशेषोपचयेऽपृथका न व्यहीयत मेधावी पार्थोऽप्यस्त्रविदां वरः॥ अर्जुनः परमं यत्नमातिष्ठद् गुरुपूजने। अस्त्रे च परमं योगं प्रियो द्रोणस्य चाभवत्॥
en: Thereupon he filled his Kamandala with the Varuna weapon and came to his preceptor at the same time with his preceptor's son and thus the intelligent son of Pritha, that foremost of all the learned in arms, became in no way inferior to his preceptor's son. Arjuna took great deal of care in worshipping the preceptor; he had great devotion of his study of the science of arms, therefore, he became a great favourite of Drona.

sa: तयोस्तद्भाषितं श्रुत्वा कौतूहलसमन्वितम्। कथयामास काकुत्स्थस्तस्य राज्ञो यथागमम्॥
en: Hearing those words begotten of curiosity, Rāma engaged in relating the whole story as he had heard before, saying.

sa: यान्बुध्वा पुरुषः सम्यक्सर्वज्ञत्वमवाप्नुयात्। मोक्षधर्माश्च कथिता विचित्रा बहुविस्तराः॥
en: If a person understands them, he attains to, consummate knowledge. The mysteries of final emancipation is also elaborately discussed.

sa: निमित्तभूतस्तत्रासीद् विश्वामित्रः पराशर। राजा कल्माषपादश्च दिवमारुह मोदते॥
en: O Parashara, Vishvamitra was mere an instrument in that matter. The king Kalmashapada, also ascending heaven, enjoy great happiness.

sa: पञ्चैते जज्ञिरे राजन्वीर्यवन्तो महासुराः। केकयेषु महात्मान: पार्थिवर्षभसत्तमाः॥
en: O king, these powerful great Asuras were all born in the illustrious dynasty of Kekaya and became great kings.

sa: तेनेदं शक्रतुल्येन दिव्यमाभरणं मम। तस्मिन्निमित्ते काकुत्स्थ दत्तमद्भुतदर्शनम्॥
en: It is for this reason, O Kākutstha, that royal saint, resembling Indra, conferred upon me this wondrous, celestial ornament.

sa: धर्मे मतिर्भवतु वः सततोत्थितानां स ह्येक एव परलोकगतस्य बन्धुः। अर्थाः स्त्रियश्च निपुणैरपि सेव्यमाना नैवाप्तभावमुपयान्ति न च स्थिरत्वम्॥
en: O Rishis, be up and doing. Let your hearts be fixed in virtue, for virtue is the only friend in the other world. Even the most intelligent men can never make their wealth and wives their own hy carefully cherishing them. They are not things lasting.

sa: अभ्यवादयत प्रीत्या विनयावनतस्तदा। तदहमासनं तस्मै सम्प्रदाय यथाविधि॥
en: Bowing low with humility, he saluted him with joy, and hither offered him with due ceremonies, a befitting seat.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इतिहासमिमं विप्राः पुराणं परिचक्षते। कृष्णद्वैपायनप्रोक्तं नैमिषारण्यवासिषु॥
en: Sauti said: m The Brahmanas call this history, recited by Krishna Dvaipayana, a Purana, to the dwellers of Naimisharanya.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा व्याहृतं वाक्यं रक्षसा ब्रह्मरूपिणा। सूदान्संस्कारकुशलानुवाच पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: Hearing the words of the Rākşasa in the guise of a Brāhmaṇa, the king ordered his expert cooks, saying.

sa: भीष्मः खलु पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया सत्यवतीं मातरमुदवाहयत्; यामाहुर्गन्धकालीति॥
en: Bhishma, being desirous of doing good to his father, got him married to Satyavati, who was also called Gandhakali.

sa: अथर्भपुत्र: कौन्तेय कुरूणामृषभो बली। सूर्यमाराधयामास नृपः संवरणस्तदा।॥
en: O son of Kunti, that best of the Kurus, the son of Riksha, the mighty king Samvarana, worshipped Surya

sa: अवाचीनोऽपि वैदर्भीमपरामेवोपयेमे मर्यादां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अरिहः॥
en: Avachina married another princess of the Vidharbha kings, called Maryada and she gave birth to a son, named Ariha.

sa: तथेमे सर्वपञ्चाला दुष्यन्तपरमेष्ठिनोः। अन्वयाः कुशिका राजन् जह्रोरमिततेजसः॥
en: All the Panchalas were descended from Dushyanta and Parameshti. The Kushikas were the descendants of the greatly effulgent Jahnu.

sa: माकन्दीमथ गङ्गायास्तीरे जनपदायुताम्। सोऽध्यावसद् दीनमनाः काम्पिल्यं च पुरोत्तमम्॥ दक्षिणांश्चापि पञ्चालान् यावच्चर्मण्वती नदी। द्रोणेन चैवं द्रुपदः परिभूयाथ पालितः॥
en: (Receiving the territory named) Makandi with many towns and cities, situated on the banks of the Ganges, Drupada lived in the best of cities, called Kampilya. After his defeat by Drona, he (Drupada) also ruled over the southern Panchala upto the banks of the Charmanavati river.

sa: एवमुक्तः सुरैः सर्वैर्निमेश्चेतस्तदाब्रवीत्। नेत्रेषु सर्वभूतानां वसेयं सुरसत्तमाः॥
en: There upon being addressed by the celestials the consciousness said I may live in the eyes of the celestials.

sa: वायुनाऽतीव सहसा क्षोभ्यमाणं महास्वनम्। तिमिगिलसमाकीर्णं मकरैरावृतं तथा॥
en: (But) greatly agitated all on a sudden by the wind. (It was) terribly roaring, full of Timingilas and Makaras.

sa: अष्टक उवाच अहं मन्ये पूर्वमेकोऽस्मि गन्ता सखा चेन्द्रः सर्वथा मे महात्मा। मेकोऽत्यगात् सर्ववेगेन वाहान्॥
en: Ashtaka said: I always thought that Indra was my special friend and that I shall, of all others, first obtain admittance into heaven. But how is it that Sibi, the son of Ushinara, has already left us behind?

sa: तस्यैवं चिन्तयानस्य भवनं शशिसंनिभम्। रामस्य परमोदारं पुरस्तात्समदृश्यत॥
en: While proceeding with this thought he saw the highly picturesque palace of Rāma resembling the rays of the moon.

sa: ततो परस्मिन्संप्राप्ते काले कस्मिंश्चिदेव तु। परिक्षिन्नाम राजासीद्ब्रह्मन्कौरववंशजः॥
en: O Brahmana, once upon a time there was a king, named Parikshit, born in the race of the Kurus.

sa: देवा वासुकिना सार्धं पितामहमथाब्रुवन्। भगवञ्च्छापभीतोऽयं वासुकिस्तप्यते भृशम्॥
en: The celestial with Vasuki addressed the Grandsire thus, “O lord, Vasuki is suffering from the fear of the curse.

sa: चिरं गतं पुन: कन्या पित्रे तं संन्यवेदयत्। विप्रेण पुनराहूतो विद्यया गुरुदेहजः। पुनरावृत्य तद् वृत्तं न्यवेदयत तद् यथा॥
en: Finding him again late in coming home, that maiden again told her father what had happened. Having been again summoned by that Brahmana (Shukra) to come home, Kacha appeared before the daughter of his preceptor. He again repeated to her all that had happened to him.

sa: कृतकृत्योऽद्य सुग्रीवो वैरेऽस्मिन्नतिदारुणे॥ यस्य रामविमुक्तेन हृतमेकेषुणा भयम्।
en: Surely has Sugrīva satisfied his hostile intention to-day, whose fear has been removed by one shaft, discharged by Rāma.

sa: नानाविधाननरसान् वन्यमूलफलाश्रयान्। तेभ्यो ददौ तप्ततपा वासं चैवाभ्यकल्पयत्॥
en: And that one of fiery austerities assigned quarters, along with beasts and birds as well as ascetics, for Rāma.

sa: विन्ध्यमेरुगिरिप्रख्यैः प्रासादै कभूमिभिः। ददर्श गिरिनद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र राघवः॥
en: And Lakşmaņa beheld there many spacious buildings like to the hills Vindhya and Meru and rivers of clear water.

sa: वारमुख्यास्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा वनं प्रविविशुर्महत्। आश्रमस्याविदूरेऽस्मिन् यत्नं कुर्वन्ति दर्शने॥ ऋषेः पुत्रस्य धीरस्य नित्यमाश्रमवासिनः। पितुः स नित्यसंतुष्टो नातिचक्राम चाश्रमात्॥
en: In accordance with the instructions, the courtezans entered that great forest; and remaining at some distance from the hermitage, endeavoured to meet with the sober son of the saint ever dwelling in the woods. And satisfied with serving his sire, he never strayed from the hermitage.

sa: अथ राजा दशरथः प्रियातिथिमुपस्थितम्॥ दृष्ट्वा परमसत्कारैः पूजनार्हमपूजयत्।
en: Then king Dasaratha, on having that dear guest with him, rendered to him all the respect that he deserved.

sa: शत्रुघ्नस्त्वतुलमतिस्तु ते सहायः सौमित्रिर्मम विदितः प्रधानमित्रम्। चत्वारस्तनयवरा वयं नरेन्द्र सत्यस्थं भरत चराम मा विषीद॥
en: Śatrughna endued with cleverness is your helper: Sumitrā's son is well known as my best friend. We four worthy sons of that foremost of monarchs will keep him established in truth, O Bharata. Let not your mind despond.

sa: अथारुरोह तेजस्वी स्वयं लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। ततो निषादाधिपतिर्णहो ज्ञातीनचोदयत्॥
en: That energetic elder brother of Lakşmaņa next ascended himself. Then the lord of the Nişadas, Guha, incited his kinsfolk.

sa: रामोऽपि सहसौमित्रिः किंचिदागतविस्मयः। प्रशस्य मुनिशार्दूलं निद्रां समुपसेवते॥
en: Rāma too along with Sumitrā's son having in admiration praised that tiger among ascetics, enjoyed the luxury of slumber.

sa: क्षीरोदं समतिक्रम्य तदा द्रक्ष्यथ वानराः॥ जलोदं सागरं शीघ्रं सर्वभूतभयावहम्। तत्र तत्कोपजं तेजः कृतं हयमुखं महत्॥ अस्याद्भुतं महावेगमोदनं सचराचरम्। तत्र विक्रोशतां नादो भूतानां सागरौकसाम्। श्रूयते चासमर्थानां दृष्ट्वाभूद् वडवामुखम् ॥
en: Leaving behind Ksiroda, O monkeys, you will soon after behold the Jaloda sea, striking terror into all beings. There presideth that mighty ireborn Energy of him*. (embodied in) the mouth of a mule. This wondrous (universe) containing mobile and immobile things and fraught with great impetus, is the aliment of this Energy. There are heard the cries of feeble creatures inhabiting the sea, who began to wail on witnessing the mouth of the mule. *Sage Aurvi.

sa: ब्रह्मदण्डं समुद्यम्य कालदण्डमिवापरम्। वसिष्ठो भगवान् क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The worshipful Vasiştha also on his part, raising a Brahmā staff resembling another staff of Kala, exclaimed in wrath.

sa: धुमत्सेनसुतं वीरं सत्यवन्तमनुव्रताम्। सावित्रीमिव मां विद्धि त्वमात्मवशवर्तिनीम्॥
en: Know me to be perfectly under your influence like to Sāvitri, following her husband Satyavān, the son of Dyumatsen.

sa: कार्तिके समनुप्राप्ते त्वं रावणवधे यत। एष नः समयः सौम्य प्रविश त्वं स्वमालयम्॥ अभिषिञ्चस्व राज्ये च सुहृदः सम्प्रहर्षय।
en: You shall engage in endeavours to bring about the destruction of Rāvana, after Kārtika sets in. This is not the proper time, O gentle one, and do you enter your own city. And being installed on the throne do you enhance the joy of your friends.

sa: दिव्यां भद्रासनयुतां शिबिकां स्यन्दनोपमाम्। पक्षिकर्मभिराचित्रां दुमकर्मविभूषिताम् ॥
en: It had a celestial throne and was like to a warchariot and had trees and birds painted on it.

sa: दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च। रामो राज्यमुपासित्वा ब्रह्मलोकं प्रयास्यति॥
en: And having reigned for ten thousand and as many hundred years. Rāma will depart for the regions of Brahmā.

sa: प्रयाते तु सहस्राक्षे राघवः सपरिच्छदः। अग्निहोत्रमुपासीनं शरभङ्गमुपागमत्॥
en: When the thousand-eyed one had gone away, Rāghava accompanied by his companions appeared before Sarabhanga in the (Agni-hotra) chamber.

sa: प्रमादाच्चरितं किंचित् कच्चिन्नावरजस्य मे। लक्ष्मणस्यर्षिभिर्दष्टं नानुरूपं महात्मनः॥
en: Have the sages seen my younger (brother), the high-souled Lakṣmaṇa, do anything from inadvertence that in unworthy of him?

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु कुपितः खङ्गमुद्धृत्य लक्ष्मणः। कर्णनासस्तनं तस्या निचकर्तारिसूदनः॥
en: Thereat, exercised with ire, Laksmana, the subduer of foes, uplifting his dagger, chopped off her nose, ears and breast.

sa: रामोऽपि रात्रिशेषेण तेनैव महदन्तरम्। जगाम पुरुषव्याघ्रः पितुराज्ञामनुस्मरन्॥
en: That best of men, Rāma, remembering his father's commanded cleared a large tract of country before the night terminated.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा देवेश सर्वलोकपितामहः। यथागतं तथागच्छद् देवलोकं महायशाः॥
en: Having said this, the illustrious lord of the celestials the Grand-sire of all creatures, went to the celestial regions.

sa: तयोस्तु क्रोधसंरम्भात् परस्परजयैषिणोः। युद्धं समभवद् घोरं दुन्दुभेलिनस्तथा।॥
en: Both of them desired to subdue each other and thus there arose a terrible conflict between Vali and Dundhubhi.

sa: न वानरः स्थास्यति साधुवृत्ते न मन्यते कर्मफलानुषङ्गान्। न भोक्ष्यते वानरराज्यलक्ष्मी तथा हि नातिक्रमतेऽस्य बुद्धिः॥
en: That monkey shall not follow the actions of the pious, shall not think of the great fruit (the accession of kingdom) reaped by our friendship; kingdom because he has not the right understanding to make good his promise.

sa: एते चाप्यभिषेकाः मुनयः कलशोद्यताः। सहिता उपवर्तन्ते सलिलाप्लुतवल्कलाः॥
en: And these ascetics having bathed, are wending their way in a body, carrying waterpitchers, their barks drenched with water.

sa: उत्सवश्च महानासीदयोध्यायां जनाकुलः। रथ्याश्च जनसम्बाधा नटनर्तकसंकुलाः॥ गायनैश्च विराविण्यो वादनैश्च तथापरैः। विरेजुर्विपुलास्तत्र सर्वरत्नसमन्विनाम्॥ प्रदेयांश्च ददौ राजा सूतमागधबन्दिनाम्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ वित्तं गोधनानि सहस्रशः॥
en: And high festivities were commenced by the multitude in Ayodhyā. And the spacious highways became filled with players and dancers, glittering with all kinds of gems, and resounding with the music of singers and performers on instruments. And the king bestowed gifts upon bards and genealogists and panegyrists, and he also gave kine by thousands to Brāhmaṇas.

sa: आचचक्षेऽथ सद्भावं लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः। भरतायाप्रमेयाय गुहो गहनगोचरः॥
en: Guha, acquainted with the forest, described to Bharata of immeasurable prowess the regard the high-souled Laksmana bore to Rama.

sa: तथेति भरतो वाक्यं वसिष्टस्याभिपूज्य तत्। ऋत्विक्पुरोहिताचार्यास्त्वरयामास सर्वशः॥
en: Thereupon honouring his words by saying, "So be it,” he urged speed upon all the Rtvigs, priests, and Acāryas.

sa: तलैरशनिकल्पैश्च वज्रकल्पैश्च मुष्टिभिः। जघ्नतुः समरेऽन्योन्यं भ्रातरौ क्रोधमूर्च्छितौ॥
en: The two brothers, exercised with ire, struck each other with palms like to Asani and with fists resembling adamant.

sa: इमं हि सालं प्रहितस्त्वया शरो न संशयोऽत्रास्ति विदारयिष्यति। अलं विमर्शेन मम प्रियं ध्रुवं कुरुष्व राजन् प्रतिशापितो मया॥
en: Doubt there is none that this arrow flung by you shall bore this Sāla tree. There is no need of discussion any more; do you perform, O king, what do you think proper for me, contracted, as you had, friendship with me, with a solemn vow.

sa: रावणं सर्वभूतानां सर्वलोकभयावहम्॥ राक्षसी भ्रातरं क्रूरं सा ददर्श महाबलम्। तं दिव्यवस्त्राभरणं दिव्यमाल्योपशोभितम्॥ आसने सूपविष्टं तं काले कालमिवोद्यतम्।. राक्षसेन्द्रं महाभागं पौलस्त्यकुलनन्दनम्॥ उपगम्याब्रवीद् वाक्यं राक्षसी भयविह्वला। रावणं शत्रुहन्तारं मन्त्रिभिः परिवारितम्॥
en: And railing furiously at all creatures; the inspirer of fear in all beings. And the Räkşasas beheld her exceedingly powerful and cruel brother, wearing gorgeous apparel and ornaments, and decked in a glorious garland, seated, like the Destroyer at the time (of dissolution) ready (to destroy); the exalted chief of Rākşasas; the delight of the race of Paulastya. Stupefied with fear, the Rākşasī, approaching that destroyer of foes, Rāvana, surrounded by his counsellors, said these words.

sa: बाल्यात् प्रभृति सुस्निग्धो लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मिवर्धनः॥ रामस्य लोकरामस्य भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य नित्यशः। सर्वप्रियकरस्तस्य रामस्यापि शरीरतः॥ लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मिसंपन्नो बहिःप्राण इवापरः। न च तेन विना निद्रां लभते पुरुषोत्तमः॥ मृष्टमन्त्रमुपानीतमश्नाति न हि तं विना।
en: And even from early youth, that enhancer of auspiciousness Laksmana was ever attached to his eldest brother Rāma, that delight of all. And like to another life of Rāma, Lakşmaņa furnished with auspiciousness was in everything attentive to Rāma's wishes, even at the neglect of his own person. And that foremost of persons did not even attain sleep without Rāma's company, nor did he partake any sweetmeat that was offered, unless Rāma partook it with him.

sa: रमणीयान् बहुविधान् पादपान् कुसुमोत्करान्। सीतावचनसंरब्ध आनयामास लक्ष्मणः॥
en: And hearing Sita's words, Laksmana brought to her (fruits and flowers) of beautiful and flower-scattering trees of divers kinds.

sa: अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। उमापतिः पशुपति राजानमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And when the yea was complete, Uma's lord, Pasupati, worshipped of all the worlds, spoke to the king, saying,

sa: नाराजके जनपदे नराः शास्त्रविशारदाः। संवदन्तोपतिष्ठन्ते वनेपूपवनेषु वा॥
en: In a kingless country persons well versed in learning can not engage in controversy, repairing to woods and groves.

sa: सज्जीभवन्तु प्लवगाः शिबिकावाहनोचिताः। समर्था बलिनश्चैव निहरिष्यन्ति वालिनम्॥
en: Let the monkeys dress themselves who can convey this hearse. The powerful and the capable only shall carry Vali.

sa: फलमूलेन जीवन्तो हिमवन्तमुपाश्रिताः। तेषां कोटिसहस्राणां सहस्रं समवर्तत॥
en: And of those dwelling in Himālaya, subsisting on fruits and roots, numbering a thousand and kotis, a thousand appeared.

sa: स तत्र कैलासनिभाः स्वलंकृताः प्रविश्य कक्ष्यास्त्रिदशालयोपमाः। प्रियान् वरान् राममते स्थितान् बहून् व्यपोह्य शुद्धान्तमुपस्थितो रथी।॥
en: Then that charioteer entering several apartments, well adorned and resembling the Kailāsa hill and the abode of the celestials and passing by many persons, dear to Rāma and abiding in his purpose, entered the apartment of the ladies.

sa: सोऽहं भुजाभ्यां दीर्घाभ्यां संक्षिप्यास्मिन्वनेचरान्॥ सिंहद्वीपिमृगव्याघ्रान् भक्षयामि समन्ततः।
en: Thenceforth, stretching out my long arms I used to devour all lions, tigers, wolves and deer ranging the forest.

sa: ते तानि वेश्मानि महाधनानि दुःखेन दुःखोपहता विशन्तः। नैव प्रजग्मुः स्वजनं परं वा निरीक्ष्यमाणाः प्रविनष्टहर्षाः॥
en: And entering their wealthy mansions, they deprived of their senses by grief, could not recognize them for their own, nor could they with their hearts rendered absolutely cheerless, although looking at them minutely, distinguish their own from others.

sa: वन्यैर्माल्यैः फलैर्मूलैः पक्वैाँसैर्यथाविधि। अद्भिर्जपैश्च वेदोक्तैर्दभैश्च ससमित्कुशैः।। तौ तर्पयित्वा भूतानि राघवौ सह सीतया। तदा विविशतुः शालां सुशुभां शुभलक्षणौ।।
en: And having with garlands made of wild flowers, fruits roots, meat cooked according to the ordinance, water, Fapa as prescribed by the Veda, grass, and faggot, worshipped the spirits, those descendants of Raghu, the auspicious Rāma and Lakşmaņa, in company with Sītă entered the graceful mansion.]

sa: अथ तस्याप्रमेयस्य वचनं परिपृच्छतः। विश्वामित्रो महातेजा व्याख्यातुमुपचक्रमे॥
en: Hearing those words of Rāma of measureless prowess, who had asked the question, the highly energetic Viśvāmitra answered, saying,

sa: तमुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठं जाम्बवान् वाक्यकोविदः। ज्ञापते गमो शक्तिस्तव हवृक्षसत्तम॥ कामं शतसहस्रं वा नह्येष विधिरुच्यते। योजनानां भवाशक्तो गन्तुं प्रतिनिवर्तितुम्॥
en: Thereat, Jāmbavān, cognizant of speech, said to that foremost of monkeys,-0 foremost of leonine as, we know your power of motion, you are capable of ursing a hundred thousand Yojanas, as well as of coming back. But we say that even this is what is fit.

sa: प्रसादयित्वा सुग्रीवं वचनैः सार्थनिश्चितैः। आसीनं पर्युपासीनो यथा शक्रं मरुत्पतिम्॥ सत्यसंधौ महाभागौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। मनुष्यभावं सम्प्राप्तौ राज्याही राज्यदायिनौ ॥ तयोरेको धनुष्पाणिभरि तिष्ठति लक्ष्मणः। यस्य भीताः प्रवेपन्तो नादान् मुञ्चन्ति वानराः॥
en: Satisfying Sugrīva with words pointing out his welfare, they sitting by him, spoke to that lord of wind resembling the king of celestials, saying: Of those two great and truthful brothers Rāma and Lakşmaņa, who are born as men, worthy of attaining to kingdom and who have gained for you your kingdom, Laksmana, with a bow in his hand, is waiting at your gate. And afraid of whom, the monkeys, trembling, are setting up terrible roars.

sa: तमापतन्तं सहसा वालीपुत्रोऽङ्गदस्तदा॥ रावणोऽयमिति ज्ञात्वा तलेनाभिजघान ह।
en: And as he darted suddenly, Angada, the son of Vali, knowing, This is Ravana, administered to him a slap.

sa: विकर्षर्मिजालानि बृहन्ति लवणाम्भसि। पुष्लुवे कपिशार्दूलो विकिरनिव रोदसी॥
en: Pushing up multitudes of high-heaving billows from the salt waters, that tiger-like monkey rushed on separating earth and heaven.

sa: हनुमत्प्रमुखास्तावत् प्रस्थिताः प्लवगर्षभाः। विन्ध्यमेवादितः कृत्वा विचेरुश्च समन्ततः॥
en: And the monkey chiefs, headed by Hanumān, having set out (on the search), began to range all through Vindhya.

sa: किमेतदिच्छेयमहं श्रोतुं प्रव्याहतं त्वया। यस्मात् त्वमागतो देशमिमं चीरजटाजिनी॥ यन्निमित्तमिमं देशं कृष्णाजिनजटाधरः। हित्वा राज्यं प्रविष्टस्त्वं तत् सर्वं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: What for is this (visit of yours to the woods)? I wish to hear as clearly related by you the reason why clad in blackdeerskin and wearing matted locks, you, leaving your kingdom, have come to these regions. It behoves you to tell me all this.

sa: एवमुक्त्वापतद् भ्रातुः पादयोर्भरतस्तदा। भृशं सम्प्रार्थयामास राघवेऽतिप्रियं वदन्॥
en: Having said this, Bharata fell at his brother's feet; and sweetly addressing him, O Rāghava, solicited him once again.

sa: इत्युक्तास्तद् बिलं सर्वे विविशुस्तमिवावृतम्॥ अचन्द्रसूर्यं हरयो ददृशू रोमहर्षणम्। निशाम्य तस्मात् सिंहांश्च तांस्तांश्च मृगपक्षिणः॥ प्रविष्टा हरिशार्दूला बिलं तिमिरसंवृतम्। न तेषां सज्जते दृष्टिर्न तेजो न पराक्रमः॥ वायोरिव गतिस्तेषां दृष्टिस्तमसि वर्तते।
en: Hanumān having said this, all the monkeys went into the cave covered with darkness; without the sun or the moon, capable of making one's down stand on end. And seeing lions, and birds and beasts (ranging around), those tigerlike monkeys entered that cave covered with swans cranes darkness. And (there) neither their ken, nor their vigour, nor yet their prowess was baffled: and their speed resembled the wind, and their sight remained unimpaired albeit in darkness.

sa: अगस्त्यवचनाच्चैव जग्राहैन्द्रं शरासनम्॥ खङ्गं च परमप्रीतस्तूणी चाक्षयसायको।
en: He then, advised by Agastya, gladly possessed himself of Indra's bow, the inexhaustible arrows, the scimitar, and the quiver.

sa: पूर्वजोऽप्युक्तमात्रस्तु लक्ष्मणेन सुभाषितम्। सारग्राही महासारं प्रतिजग्राह राघवः॥
en: After Laksmana had spoken these highly sound and pleasant words, Rāma, ever taking to what is sound, accepted them.

sa: ततः शिष्यैः परिवृतौ मुनिरष्यभिनिषपतत्॥ तं ददर्शाग्रतो रामो मुनीनां दीप्ततेजसम्। अब्रवीद् वचनं वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्॥
en: And it came to pass that, surrounded by his disciples, the ascetic came (before Rāma). And Rāma saw that one of flaming energy at the head of the ascetics, and the hero said to Lakşınana, enhancer of auspiciousness.

sa: वधमप्रतिरूपं तु महर्षेस्तस्य राघवः। विलपन्नेव धर्मात्मा कौसल्यामिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Remembering the extraordinary death of the Maharsi, that righteous descendant of Raghu, lamenting his son, thus spoke to Kausalyā.

sa: अथैनं पञ्चविंशत्या नाराचानां समार्पयत्। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: Then he pierced Bhima with twenty five small shafts before the eyes of all; and that seemed highly wonderful.

sa: प्रभो॥ सहदेवं तथाऽऽयान्तं दुर्मुखः शत्रुकर्षणः। शरैरनेकसाहस्रैः समवाकिरदाशुगैः॥
en: That crusher of foes namely Durmukha, with many thousand swift-coursing arrows, covered Sahadeva who had been making towards himself.

sa: भयं मे वै जायते साध्वसं च दृष्ट्वा कृष्णावेकरथे समेतौ॥ अतीव पार्थो युधि कार्मुकिभ्यो नारायणश्चाप्रति चक्रयुद्धे। एवंविधौ पाण्डववासुदेवौ चलेत् स्वदेशाद्धिमवान् न कृष्णौ॥
en: Beholding the two Krishnas in one chariot. I am at once led by misgivings and courage. Partha is the best of all archers and Narayana with his discus is invincible, even it may be possible for one to shake off the mountain Himalaya from its place, but never can this son of Pandu and Vasudeva be shaken.

sa: अश्वत्थामा तथोक्तस्तु तव पुत्रेण मारिष। सुदीनमभिनिःश्वस्य राजानमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus spoken to your son, Ashvatthaman, O sire, depressed and sighing heavily, replied to the king sayingनैतदावर्तते राजन्नत्रं द्विर्नोपपद्यते।

sa: ब्रवीहि मे दुर्लभमेतदद्य कथं त्वया निहतः सूतपुत्रः। अनुध्याये त्वां सततं प्रवीर वृत्रे हतेऽसौ भगवानिवेन्द्रः॥
en: Tell me, therefore, how you slew the son of Suta. O hero, I have so long been expecting you even as the divine Vishnu had awaited the arrival of Indra to bring him the news of Vritra's death.

sa: वार्ष्णेयं सात्यकि युद्धे पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव। आजघ्ने सायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नवभिनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Your son Dushasana struck in that battle Satyaki of the Vrishni race with nine sharp shafts of depressed knots;

sa: पृथिवीमुपगुह्याङ्गैः सुप्ताः कान्तामिव प्रियाम्। इमांश्च गिरिकूटाभान् नागानैरावतोपमान्॥
en: Lie slumbering on the earth and embracing her like a beloved wife. These elephants resembling mountain-peaks and huge Airavat.

sa: अन्यवयाद् भ्रातरं संख्ये पाण्डवं सव्यसाचिनम्। ततः कर्णे समुद्दिश्य त्वरमाणो धनंजयः॥ नाराचं क्रोधताम्राक्षः प्रैषीन्मृत्युमिवान्तकः। स गरुत्मानिवाकाशे प्रार्थयन् भुजगोत्तमम्॥
en: Followed his brother Savyasachin the son of Pandu in battle. Then Dhananjaya with his eyes red in rage and with great celerity sped at Karna a Naracha like the Destroyer urging death forward. Then like. Garuda ranging through the welkin in quest of a mighty snake.

sa: न कर्णोऽभ्यधिकस्त्वत्तो न शके त्वां च पार्थिव। न हि मद्रेश्वरो राजा कुर्याद् यदनृतं भवेत्॥
en: O lord of earth, Karna is in no way higher than what you are; nor that I doubt your conduct. It is sure also that the royal chief of the Madras will not achieve what should be unreal.

sa: एवं बहुविधं तस्य राज्ञश्चिन्तयतस्तदा। कृपयाभिपरीतस्य घोरं युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: When in his heart overflowing with compassion, king Yudhishthira was thus thinking, on the other part of the field.

sa: तेनार्यमानाः समरे द्रवमाणाश्च सोमकाः। व्यराजन्त महाराज प्रदीपैरवभासिताः॥
en: Crushed in that battle by him (i.e. Vrishasena) the Panchalas together with the Somakas, illuminated by lamps, shone resplendent.

sa: ततो बाणसहस्राणि प्रेषयामास पाण्डवः। सूतपुत्रवधाकाङ्क्षी त्वरमाणः पराक्रमी॥
en: Then the puissant son of Pandu quickly shot thousands of arrows, desirous of accomplishing the death of Suta's son.

sa: युध्यमाना महाराज पञ्चालाः संजयास्तथा। द्रोणमेवाभ्ययुयुद्धे योधयन्तो महारथाः॥
en: Then those mighty car-warriors, the Panchalas and the Srinjayas, engaged in that battle, O king, rushed upon Drona's self.

sa: दुपदश्च विराटश्च पुत्रभ्रातृसमन्वितौ। सात्यकि: केकयाश्चैव पाण्डवश्च धनंजयः॥
en: And Drupada and Virata accompanied by their sons and brothers and Satyaki and the Kekayas, the Pandavas and Dhananjaya.

sa: ध्वजमुन्मथितं दृष्ट्वा युयुत्सुः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः। उलूकं पञ्चभिर्बाणैराजधान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Seeing his standards thus cut-off, Yuyutsu, who became senseless with rage, struck Uluka with five arrows in the chest.

sa: धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदीनामृषभोऽतिबलोदितः। वधायाभ्यद्रवद् द्रोणं पतङ्ग इव पावकम्॥
en: Then swelling with his might, that foremost of the Chedis, viz., slaughtering him, like a fly falling upon fire.

sa: अथान्यं परिजग्राह सुपर्वाणं सुतेजनम्। सुषेणायासृजद् भीमस्तमप्यस्याच्छिनद् वृषः॥
en: Bhimasena shot at Sushena another sharp edge and decent knot arrow but Karna cut-off the same in pieces too.

sa: अथास्यं त रथं दिव्यं तिलशो व्यधमच्छरैः। पताकां चक्ररक्षांश्च गदां खङ्गं च मारिष॥ शतचन्द्रं त तधर्म सर्वोपकरणानि च।
en: Then also he with innumerable arrows, cutoff into minute fragments his (antagonist's) celestial car, his standard, the protector of his car-wheels, his mace and sword and his shield, that was furnished with hundreds of moons, as well as his all other equipment's of war, O sire.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनस्यासीन्नकुलेन समागमः। अमर्षितेन क्रुद्धस्य क्रुद्धेनामर्षितस्य च॥
en: Thereafter an encounter took place between Duryodhana and Nakula when both were filled with feelings of wrath and revenge.

sa: दुर्योधनसमादिष्टाः सोदर्याः सप्त भारत। भीमसेनमभिद्रुत्य संरब्धाः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Commanded by Duryodhana, O sire, seven uterine (Kaurava) brothers, rushing with fury at Bhimnasena surrounded him on all sides.

sa: पुत्रान् भ्रातॄन् पितॄन् दाराञ्जीवितं चैव वासविः। त्यजेत् सर्वं मम प्रेम्णा जानात्येवं हि मे गुरुः॥
en: My preceptor had all along been under the impression, that I, Vasava's son, son, could abandon all, my sires, brothers, sons, wives and even life itself, for his sake, in consequence of the affection I bear for him.

sa: अन्योयन्यस्य वधे चैव चक्रतुर्यनमुत्तमम्। कैकेयस्य द्विधा चर्म ततश्चिच्छेद सात्वतः॥ सात्यकेस्तु तथैवासौ चर्म चिच्छेद पार्थिवः।
en: Thus the two, again, made the best of their efforts in slaying each other. Then Satvata severed the shield of the Kaikeya chief into two pieces. So also this Vinda severed the shield of Satyaki into two pieces.

sa: भीमसेनो महाबाहुः क्रोधमाहारयत् परम्। ततः शरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैः संक्रुद्धाशीविषोपमैः॥
en: Bhimasena of mighty arms became filled with terrible rage; then with hundreds of sharp arrows, looking like enraged snakes.

sa: स च्छाद्यमानो बाणौधैर्भीमसेनधनुश्चयुतैः। पुनरेवाभवत् कर्णो भीमसेनात् पराङ्मुखः॥
en: Covered with the myriad shafts shot from Bhima's bow, Karna once more was compelled to turn away from Bhimasena.

sa: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा सुसंरब्धानुत्स्मयन् पुरुषर्षभः। शनकैरिव दाशार्हमर्जुनो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding them highly excited, that foremost of men Arjuna smilingly addressed these words to that descendant of the Dasharha

sa: राधेयचापनिर्मुक्तैः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः॥ संछादिता महाराज पाण्डवानां महारथाः।
en: O monarch, the great car-warriors of the Pandavas, were covered with the gold-decked darts coming out of Karna's bow.

sa: प्रतार्यमाणस्तैः सर्वैरल्पबुद्धिभिरण्डजः॥ तद्वचः सत्यमित्येव मौाद् दर्पाच मन्यते।
en: Thus imposed upon by the little-witted children, the bird, out of folly and arrogance, took their words as true.

sa: नकुलस्ते सुतं राजन् विकर्णे पृथुलोचनम्। मुहूर्ताज्जितवाँल्लोके तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: O king, Nakula then vanquished in a moment your son Vikarna of expanded eyes; that indeed seemed marvellous, Oking.

sa: तत् सादिनागकलिलं पदातिरथसंकुलम्। धृष्टद्युम्नमुखं व्यूहमशोभत महद् बलम्॥
en: The huge army of the Pandavas, abounding in infantry, cavalry, elephants and cars and led by Dhristadyumna, looked magnificent.

sa: उलूकस्य रथं तूर्णमासरोह विशाम्पते। तावेकरथमारूढौ पितापुत्रौ महारथौ॥
en: Quickly ascended the car of Uluka. Then those two mighty car-warriors, sire and son, riding on the same chariot.

sa: संनिवृत्तस्ततस्तूर्णं राधेयः शत्रुकर्शनः। भीमं प्रच्छादयामास समन्तनिशितैः शरैः॥
en: Then quickly returning, the son of Radha, the subduer of enemies, covered Bhima on all sides with sharpened arrows.

sa: अक्षताभ्यामरिष्टाभ्यां हतः कर्णो महारथः। आशीविषसमं युद्धे सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम्॥
en: Thought yourselves are not wounded by your enemies, you two, who are his enemies, have killed the mighty Karna.

sa: अथ स्मयन् हृषीकेशः स्त्रीमध्य इव भारत। अर्जुनेन कृते संख्ये शरगर्भगृहे तथा॥ उपावर्तयदव्यग्रस्तानश्वान् पुष्करेक्षणः। मिषतां सर्वसैन्यानां त्वदीयानां विशाम्पते॥
en: Thereafter Hrishikesha of eyes resembling lotus petals, smiling with the greatest assurance as if he were in the midst of women, led the steeds in the arrowy hall created on the field of battle by Arjuna, before the very eyes of all your troops, O king.

sa: अभ्यराजत तेजस्वी शक्रो देवगणेष्विवा अथ दध्मुर्महाशङ्खान् धृष्टद्युम्नशिखण्डिनौ॥
en: Shone resplendent like Shakra in the midst of the celestial hosts. Thereafter Dhristadyumna and Sikhandin blew their mighty conchs;

sa: सुवर्णपुढे राचैः परकायविदारणैः। चेदिकानवधीद वीरः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: With many gold feathered Narachas capable of piercing others bodies the hence killed hundred and thousands of the Chedis.

sa: द्यौरासीत् सूतपुत्रस्य पक्षे मातेव धिष्ठिता॥ भूमिर्धनंजयस्यासीन्मातेव जयकाडिक्षणी।
en: The heavens with all the stars sided Karna and the earth backed Partha as mother wishes her son well.

sa: प्राप्तकालं सुबलवनिश्चितं बहुधा हि मे। तत्रैव पाण्डवेयस्य भीमसेनस्य धन्विनः॥ गमनं रोचते मह्यं यत्र यातौ महारथौ। न चाप्यसह्यं भीमस्य विद्यते भुवि किंचन॥
en: Surely the odds are too many for him. It is therefore high time that I should think of rescuing him. It appears proper to me that armed with the bow, the son of Pandu viz., Bhimasena should proceed to the spot where those two mighty car-warriors are. There is scarcely anything on earth that Bhima cannot bear.

sa: मर्त्यधर्ममनुप्राप्तः कर्तव्यं नान्वपद्यत। ततः समरशौण्डो वै भैमसेनिर्महाबलः॥
en: Mortal as he was, knew not what to do. Thereat that foremost combatant, the highly powerful son of Bhimasena.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। चातुर्होत्रविधानस्य विधानमिह यादृशम्॥
en: The Brahmana said Regarding it is recited the ancient story of what the institution is of the Chaturhotra (sacrifice).

sa: माद्रीपुत्रावपि तथा हयारोहौ सुसंवृतौ। जग्मतुः शीघ्रगमनौ संनद्धकवचध्वजौ॥
en: The twin sons of Madri went on two quickcoursing horses, well cased in mail, wellprotected, and equip with banners.

sa: प्रसाद्य देवान् सविभून् समस्तान् भगीरथस्तपसोग्रेण गङ्गाम्। गामानयत् तामभिगम्य शश्वत् पुंसां भयं नेह चामुत्र विद्यात्॥
en: Having, with austere penances, pleased all the gods with the Supreme Lord (Vishnu), Bhagiratha brought Ganga down on the Earth. Going to her, men always succeed in freeing themselves from every sort of fear both here and hereafter.

sa: गार्हस्थ्यं चैव याज्याश्च सर्वा गृह्याश्च देवताः। पूर्वजेन ममाक्षिप्तं शरीरं वर्जितं त्विदम्॥ नाहं तेनाननुज्ञातस्त्वामाविक्षित कर्हिचित्। याजयेयं कथंचिद् वै स हि पूज्यतमो मम॥
en: My elder brother has taken away by force from me all my houschold articles and mystical gods, and sacrificing clients, and has now left to me only this physical body of mine, and, O son of Avikshit, as he deserves all respect from me, I cannot by any means officiate at you sacrifice, unless he permits me.

sa: पापानि तु नराः कृत्वा तिर्यग् जायन्ति भारत। न चात्मनः प्रमाणं ते धर्मे जानन्ति किंचन॥
en: Indeed having perpetrated sins, O Bharata, one has to take birth in an order intermediate between that of humanity and vegetables. Those people do not know the principles of virtue who take their own hearts for their guide.

sa: ततस्तमपि कौन्तेयः समरेष्वपराजितः। जिगाय युधि दुर्धर्षो यज्ञविघ्नार्थमागतम्॥
en: Unvanquished in battle, the brave son of Kunti defeated the Nishada king who proved an impediinent to the sacrifice.

sa: एको गुरुर्नास्ति ततो द्वितीयो। यो हृच्छयस्तमहमनुब्रवीमि। तेनानुशिष्टा गुरुणा सदैव लोके द्विष्टाः पन्नगा: सर्व एव॥
en: There is one Preceptor. There is no second but him. He lives in the heart, and of him I shall now speak. Instructed by that preceptor, all snakes in the world are always possessed of feelings of enimity.

sa: भद्रां दिशं महाभागा उल्मुचुः प्रमुचुस्तथा। मुमुचुश्च महाभागः स्वस्त्यात्रेयश्च वीर्यवान्॥ मित्रावरुणयोः पुत्रस्तथागस्त्यः प्रतापवान्। दृढायुश्चोर्ध्वबाहुश्च विश्रुतावृषिसत्तमौ॥
en: Others, viz., Unmuchu, Pramuchu, Mumuchu, all highly blessed, the highly energetic Svastyatreya, the highly powerful Agastya, the son of Mitra and Varuna; Dridhayu and Urdhavahu, those two foremost and celebrated of Rishis, these live in the Southern quarter.

sa: ततो गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तैरिषुभिर्मोहितो नृपः। हयमुत्सृज्य तं वीरस्ततः पार्थमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Stupefied by the arrows shot from Gandiva, the heroic son of Bhagadatta, letting loose the horse, fled from Partha.

sa: तमालक्ष्य महाबाहुः कुरूणामृषभस्तदा। गाण्डीवं विक्षिपस्तूर्णं सहसा समुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Marking this, the mighty armed chief of the Kuru-race, speedily stretched his Gandiva, and suddenly rushed towards his enemy.

sa: शिरो नागैर्महाभोगैः परिकीर्णं महात्मभिः। भविष्यति महाबाहोः सर्वलोकेश्वरस्य च॥ चिन्तितानि समेष्यन्ति शस्त्राण्यस्त्राणि चैव ह ।
en: The head of that mighty-armed hero, that Lord of all the worlds. will be covered with many huge snakes. All weapons of attack and defence will also come to hiin as soon as he will think of them.

sa: ते वध्यमानास्तु तदा पार्थेनामिततेजसा॥ यथाप्राणं यथोत्साहं योधयामासुरर्जुनम्।
en: As they were killed by Partha of immeasurable power, they fought him, each according to his strength and prowess.

sa: धनंजयं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य धर्मराजस्य शृण्वतः। व्यासो वाक्यमुवाचेदं हर्षयन्निव भारत॥ पौत्रस्तव महाभागो जनिष्यति महामनाः। पृथ्वीं सागरपर्यन्तां पालयिष्यति धर्मतः॥
en: Seeing Dhananjaya, he said to him in the hearing of king Yudhishthira, the just and pleasing him with his words, O Bharata, Your grandson, O highly blessed one, will become a great prince! He will righteously govem the whole Earth to the verge of the sea.

sa: च्यवन उवाच अर्धं राज्यं समग्रं च मूल्यं नार्हामि पार्थिव। सदृशं दीयतां मूल्यमृषिभिः सह चिन्त्यताम्॥
en: Chyavana said I do not deserve to be purchased with half your kingdom or even the whole of it, O king! Let that price which is proper be given to these men. Do you consult with the Rishis!

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच शतेन निष्कगणितं सहस्रेण च सम्मितम्। तथा बहु प्रतीच्छन् वै पापिष्ठां पतते गतिम्॥
en: Vasishtha said If we accept even one gold coin, it will be counted as a hundred or even a thousand. If, therefor, we accept many coins, we shall surely attain to an unhappy end in the next world.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किं राज्ञः सर्वकृत्यानां गरीयः स्यात् पितामह। कुर्वन् किं कर्म नृपतिरुभौ लोकौ समश्नुते॥
en: Yudhishthira Said Which act, O grandfather is the foremost of all those that have been laid down for a king? What is that act by doing which a king succeeds in enjoying both this world and the next.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच एतद् वै वैष्णवं तेजो मम वक्त्राद् विनिःसृतम्। कृष्णवा युगान्ताभो येनायं मथितो गिरिः॥
en: Vasudeva said The fire that came out from my mouth and that resembles the all destroying Yuga Fire in splendour, and by which this mountain has been crushed and scorched is nothing else than the power of Vishnu.

sa: दशवर्षसहस्त्राणि बदर्यामेष शाश्वतः। तपश्चचार विपुलं सह गाण्डीवधन्त्रना॥
en: Accompanied by the holder of Gandiva, Vasudeva practised eternal penances in the hermitage of Badari for ten thousand years.

sa: ततो यज्ञो ववृधे तस्य राजन् यत्र देवाः स्वयमन्नानि जहः। यस्मिशक्रो ब्राह्मणैः पूज्यमानः सदस्योऽभूद्धरिमान् देवराजः॥
en: Then, O king, the sacrificial ceremony grew in splendour, wherein the celestials themselves collected the food, and Shakra the King of the a Celestials, possessed of horse, and adored by the Brahmanas, become all assistant at the sacrifice.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच जानामि ते गुरुमेनं तपोधनं बृहस्पतेरनुजं तिग्मतेजसम्। यस्याह्वानादागतोऽहं नरेन्द्र प्रीतिर्मेऽद्य त्वयि मन्युः प्रनष्टः॥
en: Indra said I know your priest, this highly energetic ascetic, the younger brother of Brihaspati, at whose invitation I have come to this sacrifice, I am, o king, well-pleased with you, and my anger against you is gone.

sa: तं युध्यमानं राजानं क्षत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितम्॥ पार्थोऽब्रवीन मे वध्या राजानो राजशासनात्। अलं युद्धेन ते वीर न तेऽस्त्वद्य पराजयः॥
en: To the Gandhara king who was fighting with him, moved by Kshatriya duty, Arjuna said, I do not intend to kill the kings who fight with me, on account of the commands of Yudhishthira. O hero, Cease to fight with me. Do not scek defeat today.

sa: भीष्म उवाच क्षत्रियस्यापि भर्ये द्वे विहिते कुरुनन्दन। तृतीया च भवेच्छूद्रा न तु दृष्टान्ततः स्मृता।॥
en: Bhishma said The Kshatriya, O delighter of the Kurus can take two wives. The Kshatriya may take a third wife from the Shudra caste. Such practice prevails, it is true, but it is not sanctioned by the scriptures.

sa: दृष्ट्वा ऋतुसहस्रेण वाजपेयशतेन च। तर्पयामास विप्रेन्द्रांस्त्रिभिः काञ्चनपर्वतैः॥
en: Having celebrated a thousand sacrifices and a hundred Vajapeyas, he pleased the lcading Brahmanas with three mountains of gold.

sa: हतानात्मजाञ्श्रुत्वाप्रमत्ताः पुरुषर्षभाः। निरीक्षन्तः पदं शूराः क्षिप्रमेव यशस्विनि॥
en: Informed of the massacre of their sons, those foremost infuriate with rage, those heroes,-Oillustrious lady, will soon pursue us.

sa: पीडयित्वा तु राजानं शरैगशीविषोपमैः। अभ्यधावत् पुनर्भीमं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Afflicting the king with arrows that resembled Venomous serpents Shalya proceeded against Bhima, covering him with showers of arrows.

sa: ततो देवाः समेताश्च ब्रह्माणामिदमब्रुवन्। वधाय रक्षसस्तस्य बलविप्रकृतास्तदा॥
en: The gods, oppressed by the power of the Rakshasa, assembling together, approached Brahman, for bringing about their enemy's destruction.

sa: पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तः सोमदत्तो जनार्दन। युयुधानं महेष्वासं गर्हयन्निव दृश्यते॥
en: Burning with sorrow at the death of his son, Somadatta, O Janarddana, seems to blame the great bowman Yuyudhana.

sa: जयद्रथस्य कर्णस्य तथैव द्रोणभीष्मयोः। अभिमन्योर्विनाशं च कश्चिन्तयितुमर्हति॥
en: Who is there that could even imagine the death of such heroes as Jayadratha, Karna, Drona, Bhishma and Abhimanyu.

sa: अलभ्या ये शुभा भावाः स्त्रियश्चाच्छादनानि च। शय्यासनानि यानानि महार्हाणि गृहाणि च॥ पक्षिणो मृगजातानि रसगन्धः फलानि च। तेष्वेव सज्जयेथास्त्वं यथा नश्यत्वयं परः॥
en: You will then cause your enemies to be attached to such good things as are not easily · got at, to beautiful women and clothes, beds and seats and cars, all very costly, and houses, and birds and animals of various species, and juices and perfumes and fruits, so that your foe may be ruined of himself.

sa: ध्रियमाणं तच्छत्रं पाण्डुरं रथमूर्धनि। शुशुभे तारकाकीर्णं सितमभ्रमिवाम्बरे॥
en: That white a umbrella held upon the car shone like a white cloud adorned with stars in the sky.

sa: जातरूपपरिच्छनानं प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्। अवधीत्तावकान् सर्वान दण्डपाणिरिवान्तकः॥
en: Taking up his heavy golden mace he made a havoc on them like Death himself armed with his bludgeon.

sa: बभूव तीर्थप्रवरं हतेषु सुरशत्रुषु। कुमारेण महाराज त्रिविष्टपमिवापरम्॥
en: That best of Tirthas, O king after the enemies of the celestials had been killed, became a second heaven.

sa: तन्महात्मा महाभागः केतुः सर्वधनुष्मताम्। प्रत्यपादयदाचार्यः प्रीयमाणो धनंजयम्॥
en: Pleased with Dhananjaya, the illustrious preceptor, that foremost of all wielders of bows, and given him that very weapon.

sa: चरन्तीव महाविद्युन्मुष्णन्ती नयनप्रभाम्। अलातमिव चाविद्धं गाण्डीवं समदृश्यत॥
en: Moving like flashes of lighting and closing our eyes Arjuna's Gandiva is seen to resemble a circle of fire.

sa: तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि सर्वासामेव वो मतम्। यथा चेमानि कूलानि हित्वा नायाति वेतसः॥ तत्र प्राह नदी गङ्गा वाक्यमुत्तममर्थवत्। हेतुमद् ग्राहकं चैव सागरं सरिताम्पतिम्॥
en: I desire, therefore, to hear what is your motive about it. Indeed, why is it that canes, are not washed down by any of you from the banks were they grow?-Thus addressed, the River Ganga replied, to Ocean, that Lord of all Rivers, in these words of great significance, fraught with reason, and, therefore, liked of all.

sa: अवादयन् पारिषदाः प्रहृष्टाः कनकप्रभाः। गायमानास्तथैवान्ये नृत्यमानास्तथा परे॥
