en: And some sang and some danced about crying hideously, and some leapt forward and cut capers and jumped sideways.

sa: अर्थनां च पितृणां च देवतानां च भारत। आनृण्यं गच्छ कौन्तेय तत् सर्वं च करिष्यसि॥
en: Be freed first, О Bharata, from the debt you owe to persons who may beg of you to the Pitris, and to the gods. You may then, O son of Kunti, follow all the other modes of life.

sa: अलम्बुषो महाशूरो राक्षसश्चाप्यलायुधः। आर्थ्यशृङ्गिश्च निहत: किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: When king Alambusha and the Rakshasa Alayudha and Rishyashringa's on have been slain, what can it be but Destiny.

sa: एवं वसेह सस्नेहा यथाकाममर्हिसिता। यत् कृतं तत् तु मे क्षान्तं त्वंच वै क्षम पूजनि॥
en: Do you then continue to live here at your pleasure, with love for me and without fear of any injury from me. What you have done has been forgiven by me. Do you also forgive me, O Pujani.

sa: न बुद्धिशास्त्राध्ययनेन शक्यं प्राप्तुं विशेषं मनुजैरकाले। मूर्योऽपि चाप्नोति कदाचिदर्थान् कालो हि कार्य प्रति निर्विशेषः॥
en: By mere intelligence of study of the scriptures, men, if Time be not propitious, cannot acquire any earthly object. Sometimes an ignorant fool may acquire wealth. Time is the the powerful instrument for the accomplishment of all acts.

sa: त्वां तु कापुरुषं पापं विदुः सर्वे मनीषिणः। असकृत्पापकर्माणं बालजीवितघातकम्॥ तस्मात्त्वमस्य पापस्य कर्मणः फलमा जुहि।
en: As regards yourself, all wise men know you as a coward and a sinful wretch. Always engaged in sinful deeds, you are the slayer of children. Therefore, you must have to bear the fruit of your sinful deeds.

sa: आरम्भांश्चास्य महतो दुश्चरांश्च प्रयोजय। नदीवच्च विरोधांश्च बलवद्भिर्विरुध्यताम्॥
en: Make them undertake works which are difficult of accomplishment. See also that they enter into hostilities with powerful enemies.

sa: क्षत्रियस्यापि यो धर्मस्तं ते वक्ष्यामि भारत। दद्याद् राजन् न याचेत यजेत न च याजयेत्॥
en: I shall also tell you, O Bharata, what the duties of a Kshatriya are. A Kshatriya, O king, should give but not beg, should himself celebrate sacrifices but not officiate as a priest in the sacrifices of others.

sa: तावकानामनीकेषु पाण्डवा जितकाशिनः॥ व्यचरन्त महाराज प्रेक्षणीयाः समन्ततः।
en: Indeed, the Pandavas, filled with the desire of victory, O king, moved about on all sides amongst your soldiers.

sa: तान् प्रत्यगृह्णात् पुत्रस्ते मद्रराजश्च वीर्यवान्॥ महामेघानिव बहूशैलावस्तोदयावुभौ।
en: Then your son and the brave king of the Madras, like the rising the setting hills, received those assailants.

sa: ततस्तदा गदाहस्तौ दुर्योधनवृकोदरौ॥ युद्धभूमिं गतौ वीरावुभावेव रराजतुः।
en: At that time the two heroes, viz., Duryodhana and Vrikodara, shone effulgent on the field, both armed with maces.

sa: ब्रह्मदत्त उवाच अस्ति वै कृतमस्माभिरस्ति प्रतिकृतं त्वया। उभयं तत् समीभूतं वस पूजनि मा गमः॥
en: An injury, was done by us to you. You have avenged it by doing an injury in return. The account is settled. Do not leave your present residence. On the other hand, continue to live here, O Pujani.

sa: कारयित्वा ऋियास्तेषां कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। धृतराष्ट्र पुरस्कृत्य गङ्गामभिमुखोऽगमत्॥
en: Having performed their last rites, the Kuru king Yudhishthira, placing Dhritarashtra at his head, proceeded towards the river Ganga.

sa: पद्मोत्पलापीडधरास्तथा मुकुटधारिणः। माहात्म्येन च संयुक्ताः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Some had ornaments made of lotuses, and some wee adorned with flowers. They were hundreds and thousands in number.

sa: दुर्योधनस्तु भीमस्य शरेणानतपर्वणा। चिच्छेदादिश्य संग्रामे ध्वजं हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Aiming at the gold-decked standard of Bhima, Duryodhana then, with a straight arrow, cut it off in that battle.

sa: हाहाकारो महानासीद् देवदानवरक्षसाम्। तद् दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यमद्भूतं लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: The gods, the Danavas and the Rakshasas, made a loud noise seeing that exceedingly wonderful and hair stirring incident.

sa: मन्त्रिणो वालखिल्याश्च सारस्वत्यो गणस्तथा। महर्षिर्भगवान् गर्गस्तस्य सांवत्सरोऽभवत्॥
en: The Valakhilyas became his ministers, and the Saraswats his companions. The great and illustrious Rishis Garga became his astrologer.'

sa: नानादेशसमुद्भूता नानानगरवासिनः। अवस्थितास्तदा योधाः प्रार्थयन्तो महद् यशः॥
en: Born in different countries and coming from different towns, those warriors maintained their ground, desirous of gaining great fame.

sa: ततो गान्धारराजस्य पुत्रः शकुनिरब्रवीत्। युद्ध्यध्वमग्रतो यावत् पृष्ठतो हन्मि पाण्डवान्॥ ततो नः सम्प्रयातानां मद्रयोधास्तरस्विनः। हृष्टाः किलकिलाशब्दमकुर्वन्ता परे तथा॥
en: Then Shakuni, the son of the Gandhara king, said-"Fight you all in front! I, however, will kill the Pandavas from behind!”_-Then the active Madraka warriors, amongst those on our side that were advancing, were filled with joy and uttered various cries. Others also did the same.

sa: व्यूढेनासुरयुद्धेन हत्वा दैतेयदानवान्। व्यभजत् पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां ययातिनहुषात्मजः॥
en: Having killed many Daityas and Danavas duly in battle, Nahusha's son Yayati divided the whole Earth (among his children).

sa: क्षिप्रं संनद्धकवचौ सखड्गावात्तकार्मुकौ। मामास्थाय प्रतीक्षेतां रथवौ परंतपौ॥ इत्युक्त्वा रथमास्थाय प्रायदभिमुखः परान्। तपन्वगात् कृपो राजन् कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः॥
en: Put on your coats of mail soon and take your bows and swords, and wait for me here, O foremost of car-warriors.'—Having said so, Ashvatthaman got upon his car started towards the enemy. The Kripa, O king, and Kritavarman of the Satwata race, both followed him.

sa: ततः कनकपुङ्खां तां शल्यक्षिप्तां वियद्गताम्। शरवृष्टिमपश्याम शलभानामिवायतिम्॥
en: We then saw the downpour of gold-winged arrows shot by Shalya, passing through welkin like as warm of locusts.

sa: प्रजानां पालकाः सर्वे सरितः पन्नगा नगाः। देवानां मातरः सर्वा देवपल्यः सकन्यकाः॥ सहस्राणि मुनीनां च अयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। नमस्यन्ति प्रभुं शान्तं पर्वताः सागरा दिशः॥ गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव गीतवादित्रकोविदाः। दिव्यतालेषु गायन्तः स्तुवन्ति भवमद्भुतम्॥ विद्याधरा दानवाश्च गुह्यका राक्षसास्तथा। सर्वाणि चैव भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च। नमस्यन्ति महाराज वाङ्मनःकर्मभिर्विभुम्॥
en: All the presiding deities of the worlds, all the Rivers, all the snakes, the mountains, the celestial Mothers, all the wives and daughters of the celestials, thousands upon thousands and millions of ascetics, were seen to bow down to that powerful Lord who is the soul of tranquility. The Mountains, the Oceans, and the Points of the compass also did the same, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras highly proficient in music, in celestial songs, sang and hymned the praises of Bhava who is full of wonder, The Vidyadharas, the Danavas, the Guhyakas, the Rakshasas, and all created beings mobile and immobile were worshipping, in thought, word, and deed that powerful Lord.

sa: लाभालाभौ सुखदुःखे च तात प्रियाप्रिये मरणं जीवितं च। समानि येषां स्थिरविक्रमाणां बुभुत्सतां सत्त्वपथे स्थितानाम्॥
en: Gain and loss, happiness and misery, the agreeable and the disagreeable, life and death, are held in equal estimation by those men of firm mind, engaged in acquiring (divine) knowledge, and wending the path of tranquility and righteousness.

sa: कस्मादेनं समुत्सृज्य न गृहान् गच्छताशु वै॥ मोक्षधर्माश्रितैर्वाक्यैर्हेतुमद्भिः सुनिष्ठुरैः। मयोक्ता गच्छत क्षिप्रं स्वं स्वमेव निवेशनम्॥
en: Leaving him here go away forthwith. Thus addressed by me in words which are seemingly cruel but which in reality are reasonable and are directly connected with the great religion of emancipation, return he to your respective homes.

sa: महाप्रस्थानमाश्रित्य लुब्धकः पक्षिजीवकः। निश्चेष्टो मरुदाहारो निर्ममः स्वर्गकाझया॥
en: Without any attempt (for getting food) and living upon air alone, he renounced all other desires for acquiring heaven.

sa: इन्द्रायुधसवर्णाभं धनुस्तस्य महात्मनः। पिनाकमिति विख्यातमभवत् पन्नगो महान्॥
en: The great god held a rainbow-coloured bow. That bow known as Pinaka as is in reality a powerful snake.

sa: ततो महात्मा तानाह दहनो ब्राह्मणर्षभान्। वरयाम्यात्मनोऽर्थाय दुर्योधनसुतामिति॥
en: The great Agni then addressed those excellent Brahmanas, saying, I seek the daughter of Duryodhana for my own self.

sa: पराशरसगोत्रस्य वृद्धस्य सुमहात्मनः। भिक्षोः पञ्चशिखंस्याहं शिष्यः परमसम्मतः॥
en: I am the beloved disciple of the great and venerable Panchashikha, belonging to the mendicant order, or Parasara's family.

sa: वाचो वेगं मनसः क्रोधवेगं हिंसावेगमुदरोपस्थवेगम्। एतान् वेगान् विषहेद् वै तपस्वी निन्दा चास्य हृदयं नोपहन्यात्॥
en: One should govern the impulses of words, of the mind, of anger of envy, of hunger, and of lust. Given to penances for purifying his heart, he should never allow the censures (of others) to pain his heart.

sa: नारदानुगतः साक्षान्मघवांस्तामुपागमत्। कृताञ्जलिपुटो देवी निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना॥ चक्रे चानुपमां पूजां तस्याश्चापि स सर्ववित्। देवराजः श्रियं राजन् वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: Followed by Narada, Indra also proceeded towards that lady. With joined hands, he offered himself up to her, and versed as he was with all things, he adored her with unsurpassed reverence and sincerity. The adorations over, the king of gods, O king, addressed Shree thus.

sa: न च कालेन कालज्ञः स्पृष्टः शोचितुमर्हति॥ तेन शक्र न शोचामि नास्ति शोके सहायता। यदा हि शोचत: शोको व्यसनं नापकर्षति॥ सामर्थ्य शोचतो नास्तीत्यतोऽहं नाद्य शोचिमि।
en: Conversant as I am with the virtues of Time, I should not grieve when it is Time that has attacked me. It is therefore, O Shakra, that I do not grieve. Grief can do us no good. The grief of one that indulges in grief never dissipates his calamity. On the other hand, grief destroys his power. It is therefore that I do not grieve.

sa: नोर्ध्वं नावाङ् न तिर्यक् च न क्वचिच्छक कामये। न हि ज्ञेये न विज्ञाने न ज्ञाने कर्म विद्यते॥
en: I do not, O Shakra, at any time seek either heaven, or this world, or the nether regions. It is not the fact that there is no happiness in understanding the Soul. But the Soul, being dissociated from everything, cannot enjoy happiness. Hence I desire nothing.

sa: सर्वः स्वानि शुभाशुभानि नियतं कर्माणि जन्तुः स्वयं गर्भात् सम्प्रतिपद्यते तदुभयं यत् तेन पूर्वं कृतम्। मृत्युश्चापरिहारवान् समगति: कालेन विच्छेदिना दारोश्शूर्णमिवाश्मसारविहितं कर्मान्तिकं प्रापयेत्॥
en: A creature obtains from the very time of his residence in the mother's womb all his own acts good and bad that were acquired by him in his pristine lives. Death, which is irresistible, helped by Time which encompasses the destruction of life, takes all creatures to their end like wind scattering the dust of sawed timber.

sa: शापश्च सुमहांस्तस्य दत्तः सुरगणैस्तदा। कुक्षौ पुनर्वाः पापोऽयं जनयित्वाचिरात् सुतान्॥ निरयं प्राप्स्यति महत् कृतघ्नोऽयमिति प्रभो।
en: A great curse was imprecated upon him by the gods that having begouen, within a few years, upon the body of his remarried wife many children, that ungrateful sinner should sink into a dreadful hell for many years.

sa: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्। अहंकारप्रसूतानि महाभूतानि पञ्चधा॥
en: Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, and Fire numbering the fifth—these are the five Great Creatures that have originated from Consciousness.

sa: प्रवृत्तमेतद् भगवन् महर्षे महाद्युतेश्चक्रमनन्तवीर्यम्। विष्णोरनन्तस्य सनातनं तत् स्थानं सर्गा यत्र सर्वे प्रवृत्ताः। स वै महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमो वै तस्मिन् जगत् सर्वमिदं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: O illustrious Rishi, O holy one, I see this wheel of Time, endued with great energy, of the most effulgent and Infinite Vishnu, has been set in motion. Eternal is that station from which all sorts of creation originate. That Vishnu is the Supreme Soul. He is the foremost of Beings. In Him this entire universe lives.

sa: शरासनधरांश्चैव गदाशक्तिधरांस्तथा। एकः खड्गधरो वीरः समर्थः प्रतिबाधितुम्॥
en: A hero armed with the sword can, alone, withstand inany bowmen and many antagonists armed with maces and arrows.

sa: नानुरुद्ध्ये निरुध्ये वा न द्वेष्मि न च कामये। समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु पश्य मे जाजले व्रतम्।
en: I never beg of any one, I never fall out with any one; I never hate any one. I never desire for anything. I regard equally all things and all creatures. See, O Jajali, this is my vow.

sa: ये च दोषसमायुक्ता नराः प्रोक्ता मयानघ।॥ तेशामप्यधमा राजन् कृतघ्ना मित्रघातकाः। त्यक्तव्यास्तु दुराचाराः सर्वेषामिति निश्चयः॥
en: Amongst the vicious men, O sinless one, that I have mentioned, the vilest, o king, are those who are ungrateful and who injure friends. Those wicked persons should be shunned by all. This, indeed, is a settled injunction.'

sa: भवेस्त्वं यद्यपि त्वाट्यो न राजा न च दैवतम्। देवत्वं प्राप्य चेन्द्रत्वं नैव तुष्येस्तथा सति॥
en: If you become affluent, you will never become a king, nor a god. If by any means you become a god, you will then wish for the kingship of the gods. In no state you will be contented.

sa: कारुण्यादभिसंतप्तः पर्यशोचत तां द्विजः। अकार्यं कृतवानस्मि रोषरागबलात्कृतः॥
en: Became oppressed with compassion and lamented for her, saying, 'I have committed a crime forced by passion and anger.'

sa: सर्प उवाच ब्राह्मणः को भवेद् राजन् वेद्यं किं च युधिष्ठिर। ब्रवीह्यतिमतिं त्वां हि वाक्यैरनुमिमीमहे॥
en: The snake said : O king, whom can we call a Brahmana and O Yudhishthira, what is it that ought to be known? From what you have said I deem you to be endowed with very high intelligence.

sa: हृदयं चरणश्चापि वामोऽस्य परितप्यति। सव्यस्याक्ष्णो विकारश्चाप्यनिष्टः समपद्यत॥
en: And his heart and left leg began to twitch and his left eye auguring evils, began to contract. to

sa: भूतानामेव सर्वेषां यस्यां रागस्तदाभवत्। रागाद्रागेति यामाहुर्द्वितीयाङ्गिरसः सुता॥
en: Angira's second daughter was called Raga, she was so named because she was the source of all creatures' love.

sa: धनंजयश्च तेजस्वी प्रणिपत्य पुरंदरम्। भृत्यवत् प्रणतस्तस्थौ देवराजसमीपतः॥
en: (And) the energetic Dhananjaya having saluted Purandara, stood before the king of the gods, like a servant with humility.

sa: एकाकिनैव सुपहन्नलेन पृथिवीपते। दुःखमासादितं घोरं प्राप्तश्चाभ्युदयः पुनः॥
en: O ruler of the earth, Nala alone suffered such great and terrible distress, but he regained his lost glory.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच संधिं कृत्वैव कालेन ह्यन्तकेन पतत्त्रिणा। अनन्तेनाप्रमेयेण स्रोतसा सर्वहारिणा॥ प्रत्यक्षं मन्यसे कालं मर्त्यः सन् कालबन्धनः। फेनधर्मा महाराज फलधर्मा तथैव च॥
en: Bhima said : O great king, being mortal and unsubstantial as froth, unstable as fruit and dependant on time, how can you consider of any avail your having made an agreement in respect of Time, which is infinite and immeasurable, which passes as quickly as an arrow or a stream, carrying everything before it like death itself?

sa: ब्राह्मणाः सर्वकामैस्ते सततं पार्थ तर्पिताः। यतयो मोक्षिणश्चैव गृहस्थाश्चैव भारत॥ भुञ्जते रुक्मपात्रीभिर्यत्राहं परिचारिका। आरण्यकेभ्यो लौहानि भाजनानि प्रयच्छसि। नादेयं ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्ते गृहे किंचन विद्यते॥
en: O son of Pritha, you have always pleased the Brahmanas by granting all their desires; the Yatis, the ascetics, the householder ascetics, have always been fed by you on golden plates where (myself) have distributed food. You always give food and gold to Vanaprasthas; there is nothing in your house which you cannot bestow upon the Brahmanas.

sa: तं मृगेन्द्रमिवायान्तं प्रभिन्नमिव वारणम्। ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि बाणकार्मुकधारिणम्॥
en: And all the creatures beheld him appearing like a lion or a maddened bull furnished with bows and arrows.

sa: त्वरया परया युक्तस्तपसेधृतनिश्चयः। वनं कण्टकितं घोरमेक एवान्वपद्यत॥
en: Firmly adhering to his purpose, soon engaged himself in austere asceticism. He entered that fearful and thorny forest alone.

sa: क्षुत्पिपासापरीताङ्गी दुष्करं यदि जीवति। श्वापदाचरिते नित्यं वने महति दारुणे॥ त्यक्ता तेनाल्पभाग्यन मन्दप्रज्ञेन मारिष। इत्येवं नैषधो राजा दमयन्तीमनुस्मरन्। अज्ञातवासं न्यवसद् राज्ञस्तस्य निवेशने॥
en: As she, fatigued with hunger and thirst, is quite unfit to wander about in that dreadful and dense forest, always haunted by fierce animals. Cfriend! having left her in that dreadful forest, the stupid king of the Nishadhas of little fortune thus remembered Damayanti, while he was living an unknown life in the house of that king.''

sa: तथान्ये दर्पिता नागा: करेणुशरपीडिताः। सिंहव्याघ्राश्च संक्रुद्धा भीमसेनमथाद्रवन्॥
en: Some proud elephants, urged by female elephants and also some lions and tigers in great anger rushed at Bhimasena.

sa: सोऽयं त्वया महाबाहो शमितो देवकण्टकः। शतं महिषतुल्यानां दानवानां त्वया रणे॥ निहतं देवशत्रूणां यैर्वयं पूर्वतापिताः। तावकैर्भक्षिताश्चान्ये दानवाः शतसङ्घशः॥
en: O mighty armed hero, you have removed a thorn from the side of the celestials; you have killed in battle hundreds of Danavas, as brave as Mahisha, those enemies of the celestials who used to harass us always. Your followers have eaten up hundreds of Danavas,

sa: प्रतस्थे सह विप्रैस्तैर्धातृभिश्च परन्तपः। राक्षसैरनुयातो वै लोमशेनाभिरक्षितः॥
en: Set out with his brothers and those Brahmanas (for the Shveta) followed by the Rakshasas and protected by Lomasha.

sa: काश्मीरमण्डलं चैतत् सर्वपुण्यमरिंदम्। महर्षिभिश्चाध्युषितं पश्येदं भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: O chastiser of foes, behold with your brothers the sacred region of Kashmira, ever frequented by the holy Rishis.

sa: वामदेव उवाच प्रयच्छ वाम्यौ मम पार्थिव त्वं कृतं हि ते कार्यमाभ्यामशक्यम्। मा त्वा वधीद् वरुणो घोरपाशौब्रह्मक्षत्रस्यान्तरे वर्तमानम्॥
en: Vamadeva said: O king, give me my Vami horses. By them you have accomplished something which was impossible to be accomplished by you. By transgressing the practices of both the Brahmanas and the Kshatriyas, do not cause your own death by the terrible curse of Varuna.

sa: धनुरादाय गाण्डीवं देवदत्तं स वारिजम्। शोशुभ्यमान: कौन्तेय आनुपूर्व्यान्महाभुजः॥ अस्त्राणि तानि दिव्यानि दर्शनायोपचक्रमे। अथ प्रयोक्ष्यमाणेषु दिव्येष्वस्त्रेषु तेषु वै॥
en: (And)o son of Kunti, the handsome (Dhananjaya) of mighty arms, holding (in his hand) the bow Gandiva, together with the conch presented to him by the celestials, was about to exhibit in due order those celestials weapons. (But) As he commenced to display those heavenly weapons,

sa: इत्युक्त्वा राजशार्दूलस्तस्थौ गर्जनमर्षणः। एवमुक्तस्ततः कृष्णो मृदुपूर्वमिदं वचः। उवाच पार्थिवान् सर्वान् स समक्षं च वीर्यवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this, that best of men (Shishupala) stood up and roared in anger. When he ceased (talking), Krishna spoke these words in a soft voice to all the kings in the presence of the Pandavas.

sa: इन्द्रकीलं समासाद्य ततोऽतिष्ठद्धनंजयः। अन्तरिक्षेऽतिशुश्राव तिष्ठेति स वचस्तदा॥
en: He reached Indrakila and Dhananjaya (Arjuna) stopped there. He then heard a voice in the sky. It said, “stop."

sa: त्वमेवैतदशानेति तत्राह तथेति शिबिस्तथैवाविमना महित्वा कपालमभ्युद्धार्य भोक्तुमैच्छत्॥
en: "Eat it yourself." Thereupon Shibi said, “Be it so", He then without the least hesitation took down the meat.

sa: अहं स्ववीर्यादुत्तीर्य सागरं मकरालयम्। सुत जनकराजस्य सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम्॥ दृष्टवान् भरतश्रेष्ठ रावणस्य निवेशने। समेत्य तामहं देवीं वैदेहीं राघवप्रियाम्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, having crossed by my own prowess the ocean, the abode of sharks and crocodiles, I saw the daughter of king Janaka, celestials like Sita in the abode Ravana. Having interviewed with that lady, the Veda princess, the beloved of Rama.

sa: अथाब्रवीदगस्त्यस्तान् राजर्षीनृषिसत्तमः। विषादो वो न कर्तव्यो ह्यहं भोक्ष्ये महासुरम्॥ धुर्यासनमथासाद्य निषसाद महानृषिः। तं पर्यवेषद् दैत्येन्द्र इल्वलः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Thereupon that foremost of Rishis Agastya said to those royal sages. “You ought not to grieve. I shall eat up the great Asura." When the great Rishi sat on an excellent seat in order to eat, the great Daitya Ilvala laughingly began to distribute the food.

sa: नेता च त्वमृषीन् यस्मात् तेन तेऽष्टगुणं फलम्। रक्षोगणविकीर्णानि तीर्थान्येतानि भारत! न गतानि मनुष्येन्द्रस्त्वामृते कुरुनन्दन॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, as you will take all these Rishis to those Tirthas, your merit will be eight times greater. The Tirthas are infested with Rakshashas. O descendant of Kuru, none else except you can go there.

sa: ततः प्रासादयद् ब्राह्मणं भगवन् भुज्यतामिति। मुहूर्तादुद्वीक्ष्य शिविमब्रवीत्॥
en: He then gratified the Brahmanas and said "O exalted one, eat." Looking at Shibi for a moment he said.

sa: ते तु तत्रोपवासांस्तु चक्रुनिश्चितमानसाः। ब्राह्मणास्तत्र शतशः समाजग्मुस्तपोधनाः॥
en: They (the Pandavas) began to fast there with subdued mind. And there came to them hundreds of ascetic Brahmanas.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा शुभापाङ्गी भीमसेननिन्दिता। जगाम पुष्यमादायधर्मराजाय तत् तदा॥
en: Having said this to Bhimasena, that faultless lady of beautiful eyes took the flower and went to Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira).

sa: तथैव पार्थः कृष्णार्थे प्राणानपि परित्यजेत्। सुरभीश्चन्दनरसान् हेमकुम्भसमास्थितान्॥
en: Partha also can sacrifice his life for the sake of Krishna. Though, numberless golden jars filled with fragrant Chandana.

sa: स्वरूपसदृशं चैव प्रादादङ्गविभूषणम्। अभेद्यं कवचं चेदं स्पर्शरूपवदुत्तमम्॥
en: Gave me ornaments for my person worthy of his own body and this impenetrable excellent armour of pleasurable feel,

sa: तेषां प्रशमनं कार्यं स्नानं धूपमथाञ्जनम्। बलिकार्मोपहाराच स्कन्दस्यज्याविशेषतः॥
en: They are propitiated with burnt offerings, ablutions, unguents, sacrifices and other offerings and particularly by the worship of Skanda.

sa: अथ वेतसिकां गत्वा पितामहनिषेविताम्। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति गच्छेदौशनसीं गतिम्॥
en: Then going to Vetasika frequented by the Grandsire obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and acquires the state of Ganas.

sa: चूर्ण्यमानेऽश्मवर्षे तु पावकः समजायत। तत्राश्मचूर्णान्यपतन् पावकप्रकरा इव॥
en: Those crags being reduced to pieces, there ensued fire and those fragments of stones fell like sparks of flame.

sa: स समिद्धे महत्यग्नौ शरीरमुपतापयन्। जनयामास संतापमिन्द्रस्य सुमहातपाः॥
en: He exposed his body to a flaming fire. By thus practising great asceticism he filled Indra with great anxiety.

sa: हिमवत्यनुशिष्टोऽसि मेरुसावर्णिना पुरा। द्वैपायनेन कृष्णेन नगरे वारणावते॥
en: You were instructed on the mountains of Himalaya by Meru-Savarani. You were instructed in Varanavata by Krishna Dvaipayana (Vyasa).

sa: एकवस्त्रा प्ररुदती मुक्तकेशी रजस्वला। शोणितेनाक्तवसना द्रौपदी वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Draupadi, attired in one piece of cloth, stained with blood, and her hair dishevelled (proceeds along) weeping and saying.

sa: स शक्रवद् दानवदैत्यसङ्घान् विक्रम्य जित्वा च रणेऽरिसङ्घान्। विगाह्य तां पुष्करिणी जितारिः कामाय जग्राह ततोऽम्बुजानि॥
en: Having thus vanquished those Rakshasas by his prowess, as Indra did the armies of the Daityas and the Danavas, he again plunged into the lake and began to gather the lotuses with the object of accomplishing his purpose.

sa: एकवस्त्राथ पाञ्चाली पाण्डवानभ्यवेक्षता हतस्वान् हतराज्यांश्च हृतवस्त्रान् हृतश्रियः॥ विहीनान् सर्वकामेभ्यो दासभावमुपागतान्। धर्मपाशपरिक्षिप्तानशक्तानिव विक्रमे॥ क्रुद्धां चानर्हती कृष्णां दु:खितां कुरुसंसदि।
en: And in one cloth. Panchali (Draupadi) saw the Pandavas, plunged in slavery and robbed of their wealth, of their kingdom, of their attire, of their beauty, and of every object of enjoyment. Bound by the tie of virtue, they were then unable to exert their prowess.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा सधर्मात्मा भ्राता भ्रातरमच्युतम्। अर्थतत्त्वविभागज्ञः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ विरराम महातेजास्तमेवार्थं विचिन्तयन्। ततस्ते हतशिष्टा ये भीमसेनेन राक्षसाः॥
en: Yudhishthira the virtuous highly energetic and firm-minded son of Kunti, versed in the particulars of the science of profit having addressed his brother (Bhima) thus, kept quiet and began to ponder upon the matter. On the other hand the survivors of the Rakshasas slain by Bhimasena,

sa: तैस्तत्र विहरद्भिश्च रममाणैश्च पाण्डवैः। प्रीतिमन्तो महाभागा मुनय.श्चारणास्तथा॥
en: And when the Pandavas were sporting and playing there at ease, several contented and highly fortunate sages and Charanas,

sa: आयुष्मन् कस्य वा नारी यामेवमनुशोचसि। तमुवाच नलो राजा मन्दप्रज्ञस्य कस्यचित्॥ आसीद् बहुमता नारी तस्यादृढतरं वचः। स वै केनचिदर्थेन तया मन्दो व्ययुज्यत॥
en: O you blessed with longevity! whose is that lady, for whom do you lament every day?” Thus spoken, king Nala answered him, saying, There was a wretch, who had lost all his senses. He had a spouse known to many. He was false in his promises (to her). For a certain cause he was separated from her.

sa: तमासीनं महाकायाः शङ्कुकर्णा महाजवाः। उपोपविविशुर्यक्षा राक्षसाश्च सहस्रशः॥ शतशश्चापि गन्धर्वास्तथैवाप्सरसां गणाः। परिवार्योपतिष्ठन्त यथा देवाः शतक्रतुम्॥
en: Thousands of Rakshasas and Yakshas of great fleetness and huge structure and having ears resembling javelins and hundreds of Gandharvas and Apsaras sat surrounding that one who seated the gods (sit surrounding the performer of hundred sacrifices (Indra).

sa: समासाद्य बिलं तच्चाप्यखनन् सगरात्मजाः। कुद्दालैर्तेषुकैश्चैव समुद्रं यत्नमास्थिताः॥
en: Having seen that pit, the sons of Sagara axes they dug on in the sea with the greatest efforts.

sa: स भुक्तवान्नरश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम्। प्रीतश्च परितुष्टश्च तां रात्रिं समुपाविशत्॥
en: And taking that nectar-like cooked rice, Rāma, the foremost of men, was greatly delighted and spent the night there.

sa: मन्त्रस्त्रिभिर्हि संयुक्तः समर्थैर्मन्त्रनिर्णये। मित्रैर्वापि समानार्थैर्बान्धवैरपि वाधिकैः॥ सहितो मन्त्रयित्वा यः कर्मारम्भान्प्रवर्तयेत्। दैवे च कुरुते यत्नं तमाहुः पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
en: He is said to belong to the superior order, whose counsel contains the three signs (mentioned below), or who engages in works after consulting duly with friends capable or with persons having the same end in view, and some times with others, and who serve Providence.

sa: दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य समासाद्योत्तरां दिशम्। संनिवेशं ततश्चक्रुर्हरिवीरा महाबलाः॥
en: Arriving at the northern side of the Southern sea, those exceedingly powerful heroic monkeys took up their quarters there.

sa: बाणाधारासहस्रैस्तु सतोयद इवाम्बरात्। राघवं रावणो बाणैस्तटाकामिव पूरयन्॥
en: And even as clouds pour down from the sky on a pool, Råvaņa showered thousands of arrows of Rāghava.

sa: बाहवोविशिखैश्छिन्नाः शिरांस्युन्मथितानि च। पतमानान्यदृश्यन्त दुमेभ्य इव पक्षिणः॥
en: Arms severed by means of arrows and heads lying crushed, appeared like birds shot down from the top trees.

sa: नक्षत्राण्युपतिष्ठन्ति ग्रहा घोरास्तथागते। उत्पाताश्चात्र दृश्यन्ते बहवो राजनाशनाः॥
en: Evil stars arise and dreadful comets appear on such occasions. Various other portents, presaging destruction of the kingdom, appear.

sa: सहस्रबाहुसदृशमक्षोभ्यमिव सागरम्। निवार्य कृतवर्माणं सात्यकिः प्रययौ ततः॥
en: Thereafter Satyaki having successfully checked Kritavarman who reseinbled the thousand-armed Arjuna or the unagitable ocean itself, quickly advanced onwards.

sa: नान्वबुध्यत तद् राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ श्वेताश्वो वाथ कुन्ती वा द्रौपदी वा यशस्विनी। माद्रीपुत्रौ च धर्मज्ञौ चित्तं तस्यान्ववर्तताम्॥
en: King Yudhishthira thc son of Kunti, however, knew it not; nor Arjuna of white horses; nor Kunti; nor Draupadi possessed of great fame; nor the twin sons of Madri, knowing every duty and who were always engaged in acting after the wishes of Dhritarashtra. was to

sa: कामक्रोधौ पारतन्त्र्यं परिवादोऽथ पैशुनम्। अर्थहानिर्विवादश्च मात्सर्यं प्राणिपीडनम्॥
en: Desire, anger, excessive reliance on others, blaming others, calumny, waste of wealth, true quarrels, imprudence, oppression on living beings.

sa: पश्य कङ्कांश्च गृध्राश्च समवेतान् सहस्रशः॥ स्थितानभिमुखान् घोरानन्योन्यमभिभाषतः।
en: Behold those terrible Kankas and vultures in thousands sitting with faces towards one another as if holding a conversation.

sa: अद्भुतस्य प्रिया भार्या तस्य पुत्रो विभूरसिः॥ यावन्तः पावकाः प्रोक्ताः सोमास्तावन्त एव तु। अत्रेचाप्यन्वये जाता ब्रह्मणो मानसाः प्रजाः॥
en: Adbhuta had a wife named Priya and Vibhurasi was his eldest son. There are as many kinds of Soma sacrifices as the number of fires mentioned. All these fires were first born from the spirit of Brahma, but they also sprung from the race of Atri.

sa: दुष्कुलैतदयुक्तार्थं मारीच मयि कथ्यते। वाक्यं निष्फलमत्यर्थं बीजमुप्तमिवोखरे॥
en: O, Marica, what you have spoken to me, shall bear no fruit like to seeds sown into a desertland.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच तस्मात् त्वमेव राधेयं भीमसेनः सुयोधनम्। वृषसेनं च नकुलः सहदेवोऽपि सौबलम्॥ दुःशासनं शतानीको हार्दिक्यं शिनिपुङ्गवः। धृष्टद्युम्नो द्रोणसुतं स्वयं योत्स्याम्यहं कृपम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Having this in view you yourself proceed against the son of Radha; let Bhimasena proceed against Suyodhana; Nakula against Vrihsena, Sahadeva against the son of Subala, Satanika against Dushasana the best of Sinis; Shalyaki against the son of Hridika and Pandya against the son of Drona. I myself will fight with Kripa. army, I will

sa: युवाभ्यामात्मभूताभ्यां राजसूयमनुत्तमम्। सहितो यष्टुमिच्छामि तत्र धर्मस्तु शाश्वतः॥
en: Therefore, with you like my own self, I wish to engage in the most excellent and eternal Rājasūya sacrifice.

sa: दशयोजनविस्तारस्त्रिंशद्योजनमुच्छ्रितः। धरण्यां समतां यातः स बभूव धराधरः॥
en: That mountain, which (heretofore) had measured ten Yojanas in area and thirty in height, became level with the earth.

sa: शिलाप्रहाराभिहतो विद्युन्माली निशाचरः। निष्पिष्टहृदयो भूमौ गतासुर्निपपात ह॥
en: Assailed with the crag, the night-ranger Vidyanmali, having his chest crushed, fell down to the earth, deprived of life.

sa: रथिनो हस्तियन्तारो हयारोहा: पदातयः॥ अवैक्षन्ताचलैत्रः परिवार्य नरर्षभौ।
en: Car-warriors, elephant-drivers, horsemen and foot-soldiers surrounding those two foremost of men, began to witness that combat with fixed eyes.

sa: त्वं ममापनकामस्य सर्वातिथ्यं चिकीर्षतः। अन्नमन्नपते दातुमभितः श्रद्धयाहसि॥
en: O lord of all food, you should grant me abundance of food to entertain all my guests with reverence.

sa: कर्मण्यवसिते तस्मिन्सा तेनैव सहावसत्। तत्र त्रीञ्जनयामास दुर्जयादीन्महारथान्॥
en: After performing this, she lived with him; and thus were begotten on her three sons, Durjaya being the eldest.

sa: तमापतन्तं गदया विद्युन्माली निशाचरः। वक्षस्यभिजधानाशु सुषेणं हरिपुङ्गवम्॥
en: As he was descending, the night-ranger, Vidyunmālī, with his mace swiftly hit at the breast of Susena-greatest of monkeys.

sa: तमापतन्तं निशितं शरमाशीविषोपमम्। अर्धचन्द्रेण चिच्छेद लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा॥
en: Thereat, Lakşmaņa-slayer of hostile heroes-with a crescent severed that sharpened shaft resembling a venomous serpent, as it was descending.

sa: आहृताः क्रतवो मुख्याः शतं भरतसत्तम। यत्र यूपा मणिमयाश्चैत्याश्चापि हिरण्मयाः॥ शोभार्थं विहितास्तत्र न तु दृष्टान्ततः कृताः। अष्ट्वा स गतः सिद्धिं सहस्राक्षः शचीपतिः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, performed one hundred great sacrifices. There were placed at this spot for beauty, many sacrificial stakes made of gems, and many sacrificial ultras made of gold though not according to the ordinance. Here after performing those sacrifices the deity of one thousand eyes, the husband of Sachi, acquired Siddhi (final success).

sa: ततोऽतिकायः कुपितश्चापमारोप्य सायकम्। लक्ष्मणाय प्रचिक्षेप संक्षिपन्निव चाम्बरम्॥
en: Then Atikāya, enraged, setting his arrow on his bow, shot it at Lakşmaņa, as if devouring up the welkin.

sa: मूलमेवादितीश्छिन्द्यात् परपक्षस्य नित्यशः। ततः सहायांस्तत्पक्षान् सर्वांश्च तदनन्तरम्॥
en: Then you should destroy their allies and partisans. If the root (principal) is destroyed, they (allies) can never exist.

sa: प्रहरिष्यन्ति विवशा: स्नेहमुत्सृज्य दूरतः। हृष्टाः पुरुषशार्दूला: कलुषीकृतमानसाः। अविज्ञानविमूढाश्च दैवाच्च विधिनिर्मितात्॥ व्याभाषमाणाश्यान्योन्यं न मे जीवन् विमोक्ष्यसे सर्वे शस्त्रास्त्रमोक्षेण पौरुषे समवस्थिताः॥ श्लाघमानाः कुरुश्रेष्ठ करिष्यन्ति जनक्षयम्। तेऽपि पञ्च महात्मानः प्रतियोत्स्यन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Blinded by ignorance and wrath and impelled by destiny which has been ordained by the creator, those foremost of men with hearts steeped in sin will. O foremost of the Kurus, depopulate the earth by hurling all kinds of weapons with great manliness and strength and always boastfully addressing one another with words such as these, “You will not escape from me today with life.” The five illustrious sons of Pandu will fight with these (heroes).

sa: एकस्यैका प्रदातव्या न बहूनां कदाचन। सा गौर्विक्रयमापन्ना हन्यात् त्रिपुरुषं कुलम्॥ न तारयति दातारं ब्राह्मणं नैव नैव तु।
en: One cow must be given to one Brahmana. One single cow must not be given to many Brahmanas. If that cow is sold, three generations of the giver's family would be lost. Such a gift will neither rescue the giver nor the Brahmana who takes it.

sa: ततो द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञमस्तुवन् पार्थिवर्षभम्। अनुज्ञातास्ततः सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्॥
en: And having eulogised the king knowing duty, the twice-born ones, with the Monarch's leave, departed for their respective quarters.

sa: अभिमन्युर्महेष्वासो द्रुपदश्च महाबलः। युयुधानो महेष्वासो युधामन्युश्च वीर्यवान्॥
en: That fierce bow-man Abhimanyu, the highly powerful Draupada, and the Kaikeya brothers, cased in Armour, stood ready for combat.

sa: पद्मपत्रेक्षणौ वीरौ जटामण्डलधारिणौ। अन्योन्यसदृशौ वीरौ देवलोकादिहागतौ ॥
en: Having eyes resembling lotus-petals, heroic, wearing matted locks, resembling each other, have you come here from the celestial region?

sa: आकाशं तदपानीयं घोरं कान्तारदर्शनम्। न तत्र वृक्षच्छाया वा पानीयं केतनानि च॥ विश्रमेद् यत्र वै श्रान्तः पुरुषोऽध्वनि कर्शितः।
en: The way is over space. There is no water there and it is terrible to look at. There is nowhere in that region any shade of any tree, any water and any resting place, in which the traveller when fatigued, may take rest for some time.

sa: ततो जालं बाणमयं विवृत्तं संदृश्य भित्त्वा शरजालेन राजन्। द्वादशेषून् प्राहिणवं रणेऽहं ततः शक्तीरप्यधमं घोररूपाः॥
en: Seeing myself surrounded by a net of arrows, I neutralized them by another net of arrows from myself, O king and then in that battle, I shot twelve arrows by which I neutralized even those terrible looking arrows.

sa: इन्द्रोऽप्यश्रुनिपातेन सुरभ्या प्रतिबोधितः। अन्यैः समृद्धैरप्यर्थैर्न सुतान्मन्यते परम्॥
en: Instructed by the Surabhi (celestials cow), Indra came to know that the son surpasses in worth other valuable possessions.

sa: रथेन तु खरो वेगात् सैन्यस्याग्राद् विनिःसृतः। श्येनगामी पृथुग्रीवो यज्ञशत्रुर्विहंगमः॥ दुर्जयः करवीराक्षः परुषः कालकार्मुकः। हेममाली महामाली सोस्यो रुधिराशनः॥ द्वादशैते महावीर्याः प्रतस्थुरभितः खरम्।
en: Then impetuously Khara issued in his car from the van of the army*. And these twelve endowed with exceeding prowess, viz., Syenagāmí, Prthusyama, Yajñaśatru, Vihangama, Durjaya, Karavirāksa, Parusa, Kālakärmuka, Hemamāli, Mahāmāli, Sarpāsya, and Rudhirāśana posted themselves around Khara. The N.W.P. text has a different stoka. And seeing him come out on the ground, they themselves came out.

sa: रविप्रभं वज्रनाभं क्षुरान्तं पार्थे स्थितं पश्य जनार्दनस्य। चक्रं यशोवर्धनं केशवस्य सदार्चितं यदुभिः पश्य वीर॥
en: Behold, there, O hero, by the side of Janardana his discus, radiant like the Sun, nave like thunder and sharp like razor-that discus which enhances the fame of Keshava and which is always worshipped by the Yadus. son

sa: तेऽभिगम्य नमस्कृत्य वैकुण्ठमपराजितम्। ततो देवाः समस्तास्ते तदोचुर्मधुसूदनम्॥
en: Going to that unvanquished lord of Vaikuntha and bowing to that slayer of Madhu, the celestials thus addressed him,

sa: कुम्भकर्णस्तु संक्रुद्धः समारूढाः प्लवंगमैः। व्यधूनयत्तान्वेगेन दुष्टहस्तीव हस्तिपान्॥
en: Kumbhakarna mounted by those monkeys, waxing exceedingly enraged, shook them vehemently, even as mad elephants shake the drivers thereof,

sa: जज्वाल चाग्निमदनो दावाग्निरिव निर्दयः। त्वत्सङ्गमाभिसंकल्पविवृद्धो मां दहत्ययम्॥
en: The flame of lust like forest conflagration augmented by the hope of union with you burns me without mercy.

sa: कृशाश्च ये जुह्वति श्रद्दधानाः सत्यव्रता हुतशिष्टाशिनश्च। वै गवां लोकं प्राप्य ते पुण्यगन्धं पश्यन्ति देवं परमं चापि सत्यम्॥
en: The people sacrosanct in heart by virtues of observing the austerity, who execute offering in their day to day exercise, accept only residual to the offering ; Access to the abode of cows field with pleasing fragrance and their eyes see a supreme soul, the truth.

sa: के वा तत्र तनूंस्त्यक्त्वा प्रतीपं मृत्युमाव्रजन्। अमानुषाणां जेतारं युद्धेष्वपि धनंजयम्॥
en: Who were they that battle, shuffling this mortal coil, courted Death standing before them in the shape of Dhananjaya who had obtained victory even over superhuman combatants?

sa: सुकुमारो युवा शूरो दर्शनीयश्च पाण्डवः। मेधावी निपुणो धीमान् युधि सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Delicate, youthful, brave, of a handsome appearance, that son of Pandu who is intelligent, skillful, accurate in his memory, of prowess incapable of being thwarted, in battle.

sa: धर्मराजाय तत् पार्थो धनं सर्वं सवाहनम्। न्यवेदयदनुज्ञातस्तेन राज्ञा गृहान् ययौ॥
en: Partha (Arjuna) offered to Dharmaraja all the wealth and the animals brought by him. Commanded by the king, the hero went to his chamber to take rest.

sa: केवलं हि सहाया मे हनुमत्प्रमुखास्त्विमे। अतोऽहं धारयाम्यद्य प्राणान् कृच्छगतोऽपि सन्॥
en: My adherents are only these headed by Hanumān. It is for this that although reduced to the greatest straits I have been able to preserve my life.

sa: वरान् प्रादात् त्रीनेव स विद्वान् वेदयुक्तश्च सिद्धश्चाप्यषिसत्तमः। तत्र तीर्थे सुमहातपाः॥
en: Acquiring great learning and a mastery of the Vedas, that best of Rishis became highly successful in that tirtha. He then conferred three boons on that place.

sa: तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः। पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्यान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः॥
en: Such being the case, he who, owing to his uncultivated understanding and dull mind, sees his own self as the sole agency of all actions, sees nothing.

sa: स तैर्हयैर्वातजवैर्वृहद्धिः पुत्रो विराटस्य सुवर्णकः। व्यध्वंसयत् तद् रथिनामनीकं ततोऽवहत् पाण्डवमाजिमध्ये॥
en: Then breaking through the array of carwarriors with big horses fleet as the wind the son of Virata took Arjuna to the middle of the battle field.

sa: स गत्वा सरयूतीरमुपस्पृश्य कृताञ्जलिः। निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह॥
en: Having reached the banks of Sarayů and rinsed his mouth he stood there with folded palms. And having obstructed all passages he did not breathe any more.

sa: आत्मापराधात् सुमहान् प्राप्तस्ते विपुलः क्षयः। नैनं दुर्योधने दोषं कर्तुमर्हसि मानद॥
en: This awful destruction has overtaken you through your own faults; O giver of honour, it behoves you not to lay all blames on the shoulders of Duryodhana.

sa: पाण्डवाः समरे शूराः स्थिता दशिताः। तावकास्तु रणे यत्ताः सहसेना नराधिपाः॥
en: Your warriors, o king, supported by large divisions and placing Bhishma at their head, charged, putting forth all their energies, the sons of Pritha on the field.

sa: न युज्यतेऽसौ परमः शरीरी। अनेन लिङ्गेन तु लिङ्गमन्यद् गच्छत्यदृष्टः फलसंनियोगात्॥
en: The Soul does not undergo birth, growth, decay, and destruction. Acts of life being followed by effects, the Soul, clothed in body into another, unseen by others.

sa: या चैषा विश्रुता राजंस्त्रैलोक्ये साधुसम्मता। अरुन्धती तयाप्येष वसिष्ठः पृष्ठतः कृतः॥
en: O king, she who is celebrated over the three worlds and who is praised by the pious men, en that Arundhati (constellation) keeps Vasishtha on her back.

sa: ते समाज्ञाय सम्प्राप्तं यज्ञियं तुरगोत्तमम्। विषयान्तं ततो वीरा दंशिताः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Having learn that, that foremost of horses, which was intended for the sacrifice, had come to their kingdom, those heroes, accoutring themselves in coats mail, surrounded Arjuna.

sa: गर्हितं मरणं नः स्यादाखुना भक्षिते बिले। शिष्टादिष्टः परित्यागः शरीरस्य हुताशनात्॥
en: To be eaten up by the mouse in the hole is a most ignoble death. But destruction of the body by fire is praised by the wise.

sa: ततः स राजा सिन्धूना रथश्रेष्ठो महारथः। दुर्योधनस्य जग्राह पार्णि सत्पुरुषैर्वृतः॥
en: Thereupon the king of the Sindhus, that foremost of car-warrior, that highly powerful one, stationed himself on the flank of Duryodhana, being supported by many excellent warriors.

sa: तत एष्याम्यतीतेऽग्नौ विहन्तुं पांसुसंचयम्। रोचतामेष वो वादो मोक्षार्थं च हुताशनात्॥
en: When the fire will be out, I shall then come back here to remove the ashes. If you want to escape from the fire, follow my advice.

sa: अस्मास्विह विनष्टेषु भवितारः सुतास्तव। त्वयि मातर्विनष्टायां न नः स्यात् कुलसंततिः॥
en: If we are killed, you might have other children born to you, but, O mother, if you are killed, we shall have no children in our race.

sa: द्विजानां देवकार्येषु कार्येष्वन्येषु चैव हा धौम्यं पुरोधसां श्रेष्ठं नित्यमेव समादिशत्॥
en: He appointed Dhaumya, the foremost of priests to attend daily to the Brahmanas and perform all rites in honour of the gods and all other religious rites.

sa: ताभ्यां शरशतैश्छन्नं तद् बलं तव भारत। सान्धकारमिवाकाशमभवत् तत्र तत्र ह॥
en: That army, O Bharata, was shrouded with hundreds of arrows by those two warriors and the sky, on many parts of the field, was shrouded with darkness.

sa: धर्मबन्धेन बद्धोऽस्मि तेनेमां नेह मातरम्। हन्मि तीव्रण दण्डेन दण्डाहाँ पापकारिणीम्॥
en: I am bound by the fetters of religion. For this it is that I do not by a severe penalty slay my wicked mother deserving of chastisement.

sa: किं नु नस्य शरीरेऽस्ति सर्वलक्षणपूजिते। अनिष्टं लक्षणं कृष्ण येन दुःखान्युपाश्नुते॥
en: His body has every auspicious mark. What, however, O Krishna, is that sign in his excellent body for which he has always to suffer misery and discomfort?

sa: मया दत्तमिदं राज्यं स्वामिन्यसि शुभानने। भजस्व मां वरारोहे भुक्ष्व भोगाननुत्तमान्॥
en: O fair-faced one, I confer on you the whole of the kingdom; accept me O you of large ips and enjoy all the excellent objects of desire.

sa: यादृशो मे सुतः पाण्डुस्तादृशो मेऽसि पुत्रका विदुरश्च महाप्राज्ञः स्नेहादेतद् ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: O son, as my son Pandu is to me, so are you and also greatly wise Vidura. It is out of affection I tell you all this.

sa: तत्राद्भुतं परं चक्रे कृतवर्मा महारथः। यदेकः समरे पार्थान् वारयामास सानुगान्॥
en: Then the mighty car-warrior Kritavarman filled his enemies with wonder, in asmuch as the alone succeeded in resisting the sons of Pritha and their followers in battle.

sa: बुभुजुः सर्वसम्पन्नमन्नमन्ये जनाः सदा। तस्मिन् यज्ञे तु विप्रेन्द्राः संतृप्ताः परमार्चिताः॥
en: At those sacrifices of his, people partook of edibles possessed of all delicate qualities. Therefore most of the Brahmanas were greatly gratified and were most excellently worshipped.

sa: सहदेवं समीपस्थं नित्यमेव समादिशत्। तेन गोप्यो हि नृपतिः सर्वावस्थो विशाम्पते॥
en: He appointed Sahadeva to always remain by his side, for the king thought, O king, that he should always be protected by that brother of his. as

sa: एवमोश्वरसंयुक्तस्तव देहो नृपोत्तम। देव्या च राजशार्दूल दिव्यस्त्वं हि न मानुषः॥
en: O foremost of kings, thus your body was created by Ishvara himself and the goddess. Therefore, O best of kings, your origin is celestials and not human.

sa: तमापतन्तं संरब्धं शैनेयस्य रथं प्रति। घटोत्कचोऽब्रवीद् राजन् नादं मुक्त्वा महारथः॥
en: (Thereupon), the mighty car-warrior Ghatotkacha, sending forth a loud shout, said to him (i.e., Ashvatthama) who was rushing furiously towards the car of the grandson of Shini.

sa: काशिष्वपि नृपो राजन् दिवोदासपितामहः। हर्यश्व इति विख्यातो बभूव जयतां वरः॥
en: In Kashi also, O monarch, there was a king who was the grandfather of Divodasa. The foremost of victorious men, he passed by the name of Haryashva.

sa: त्वरितं सिंहसेनस्तु द्रोण विद्ध्वा महारथम्। प्राहसत् सहसा हृष्टस्त्रासयन् व महारथान्॥
en: Sinhasena also having quickly pierced the mighty car-warrior Drona, suddenly, out of delight, broke out into a laugh, inspiring terror into the hearts of the mighty car-warriors.

sa: प्रशस्यमानौ सर्वत्र कदाचित्तत्र गायकौ॥ रथ्यासु राजमार्गेषु ददर्श भरताग्रजः। स्ववेश्म चानीय ततो भ्रातरौ स कुशीलवौ॥ पूजयामास पूजाहौं रामः शत्रुनिवर्हणः। आसीनः काञ्चने दिव्ये स च सिंहासने प्रभुः॥ उपोपविष्टैः सचिवैर्धातृभिश्च समन्वितः। दृष्ट्वा तु रूपसम्पन्नौ विनीतौ भ्रातरावुभौ ॥ उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामः शत्रुघ्नं भरतं तथा। श्रूयतामेतदाख्यानमनयोर्देववर्चसोः॥ विचित्रार्थपदं सम्यग्गायकौ समचोदयत्।
en: And admired everywhere, on one occasion those singers were seen by Bharata's elder brother, in a street of Ayodhyā, sparsely scattered with stalls. And having had the brothers Kusi and Lava brought under his roof, that destroyer of enemies, Rāma, accorded those ones worthy of honour, a respectful reception. And having seated himself on a throne of excellent gold, in the midst of his brothers and counsellors, that lord, Rāma, beholding both the brothers, handsome and of modest demeanour, spoke to Laksmana, Bharata and Satrughna, saying, Do you listen to the story, fraught with excellent sense and composed in excellent measure, as sung by these ones endowed with the divine afflatus. And then he ordered the singers to begin.

sa: क्षुरो भूत्वा हरेत् प्राणान् निशितः कालसाधनः। प्रतिच्छन्नो लोमहारी द्विषतां परिकर्तनः॥
en: Unpitying and sharp, concealed in their leathern cases, striking when opportunity comes, sweeping of all hair, kings should resemble razors in the mater of destroying their enemy.

sa: तत्र भारत भीमस्य बलं दृष्ट्वाऽतिमानुषम्। व्यभ्रमन्त रणे योधाः कालस्येव युगक्षये॥
en: Your warriors, O Bharata, seeing the wonderful exploits of Bhima in that battle, careering like the King of Terrors at the end of time, became greatly agitated.

sa: हिरण्यदाः सुखं यान्ति पुरुषास्त्वभ्यलंकृताः। भूमिदास्तु सुखं यान्ति सर्वैः कामैः सुतर्पिताः॥
en: Those that have given gold go along in happiness, well adorned in ornaments. And those that have given land go along with their every desire completely gratified.

sa: अविज्ञायैव मे प्रज्ञा बालस्येव स पण्डितः। पुत्रस्य प्रीतिमान् भव शौनक॥
en: Ignorant as I am, give me wisdom like a learned preceptor to his pupil or like a father to his son. Be pleased with ine, O Shaunaka!

sa: स त्वमेवंविधं जानन् भ्रातरं मां नरर्षभ। द्रोणपुत्राद् भयं कर्तुं नार्हस्यमितविक्रम॥
en: Knowing, O foremost of men, me your brother, to be such, you should not, O you of infinite prowess, entertain any fear from the son of Drona.

sa: यदा छिनत्त्ययोऽश्मानग्निश्चापोऽभिगच्छति। क्षत्रं च ब्राह्मणं द्वेशि तदा नश्यन्ति ते त्रयः॥
en: When iron strikes against stone, or fire fights with water, or the Kshatriya stands against the Brahmana, then the strength of each of those three is destroyed.

sa: अन्धकारीकृते लोके शरीभूते महीतले। दिशः सर्वा महाराज तावकाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Darkness also spread over the place and the field of battle was covered with arrows. Your troops, O monarch, then fled away in fear on all sides.

sa: नातिदूरेग नगरं वनादस्माद्धि लक्षये। जागर्तव्ये स्वपन्तीमे हन्त जागर्म्यहं स्वयम्॥ पास्यन्तीमे जलं पश्चात् प्रतिबुद्धा जितक्लमाः। इति भीमो व्यवस्यैव जजागार स्वयं तदा॥
en: Then Bhima thought, “I think there are some towns not far off from this forest. We ought to remain awake here. But they are all asleep therefore, I myself will sit awake. When they will rise after having been refreshed by sleep, then they will quince their thirst.” having resolved this, Bhima said awake.

sa: उक्तमेतन्मया पूर्वं न तिष्ठति धनंजये। शक्यो ग्रहीतुं संग्रामे देवैरपि युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: ‘I have told you before, that when Dhananjaya stays by the side of Yudhishthira, even the celestials will not be able to capture the latter in battle.

sa: अज्ञातं च विराटस्य विजित्य वसु धर्मराट्। भ्रातृभ्यः पुरुषव्याघ्रो यथार्ह सम्प्रयच्छति॥
en: That best of men, the king of justice (Yudhishthira) having won the wealth of Virata duly distributed it without the knowledge of the monarch among his brothers.

sa: हताश्वमञ्जोगतिभिः प्रसेनः शिनिप्रवीरं निशितैः पृषत्कैः। प्रच्छाद्य नृत्यन्निव कर्णपुत्रः शैनेयबाणाभिहतः पपात॥
en: Then Prasena, if dancing with excitement, assailed the steedless grandson of Shini (Satyaki) with many straight arrows, by was in return killed by the grandson of Shini.

sa: तस्मानिशम्य सत्यं मे कुरुष्व यदनन्तरम्। धर्मयुक्तस्य धर्मार्थं पितुरासीत् तरी मम॥
en: Therefore, hearing what I say, do what is proper. My father was a virtuous man and for virtue's sake he had kept a boat (for crossing people.)

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा विरथं तत्र सुतसोमो महारथः। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां रथमारोपयत् स्वकम्॥
en: Thereupon Sutosoma, possessed of great prowess beholding Shrutakarma deprived of his chariot, took him up on his car even before the very eyes of the assembled host.

sa: तस्मिन् रौद्रे तथा युद्धे वर्तमाने महाभये। प्रावर्तत नदी घोरा शोणितान्त्रतरङ्गिणी॥
en: When that awful and fierce battle was thus raging, there started up into existence on the field of battle a hideous river, having blood for its stream,

sa: स लम्वा तपसोग्रेण ब्राह्मणत्वं महायशाः॥ विचचार महीं कृत्स्नां कृतकामः सुरोपमः।
en: Having by his severe penances gained the status of Brahman-hood, the illustrious Vishvamitra, after the fulfillment of his desire, traveled over the whole earth like a god.

sa: स भूयः शुशुभे पार्थस्ताडितो गदया रणे। उद्भिन्नरुधिरो राजन्प्रभिन्न इव कुञ्जरः॥
en: Thus struck in that battle, the son of Pritha, O king, looked beautiful, as he bled profusely, like an elephant with temporal juice trickling down its temples.

sa: तं यान्तमनुगच्छन्ति देवाः सर्वे सवासवाः। तस्मिन् सम्पूजिते प्रीता निराशा यान्त्यपूजिते॥
en: As he proceeds all the celestials with Vasava (Indra) follow him. If he is worshipped, they are gratified; and if he is not worshipped they become cheerless.

sa: श्रुत्वैतस्य पुरा शब्दमाश्रमस्था मम प्रिया। मामाहूय प्रमुदिता परमं प्रत्यनन्दत ॥
en: Formerly my dear one, while in the asylum, delighted with the music of these birds, used to attain to a greater joy addressing me to hear them.

sa: द्धर्षश्चासीत् कौरवाणां सभायाम्। सर्वे चासन् पार्थिवाः प्रीतिमन्तः कुरुश्रेष्ठं धार्मिकं पूजयन्तः॥
en: Hearing his these delightful words, the Kurus present in the assembly become exceedingly glad. All the kings, becoming much pleased, applauded the virtuous chief of the Kurus.

sa: स तीर्खा दुस्तरं वीरो द्रोणनीकमहार्णवम्। प्राप्य दौःशासनिं कार्णिः प्राप्तो वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Having crossed the ocean-like host of Drona's troops difficult of being defeated, that nephew of Krishna was despatched to Death's mansion, upon encountering the son of Dushasana.

sa: नहि तां सूक्ष्मपक्ष्माक्षीं सुकेशी मृदुभाषिणीम्॥ अपश्यतो मे सौमित्रे जीवितेऽस्ति प्रयोजनम्।
en: O Saumitri, of what avail is this life to me, lot beholding Sītā of sweet accents, having eyes with their eye-lashes, and a head of curly hair.

sa: आयाति त्वयि दुर्धर्षे वाति पुण्यः समीरणः। तव गन्धानुगस्तात येनास्मान् सुखमागमत्॥
en: At your approach, O invincible one, a delightful breeze has begun to blow, bearing the sweet smell of your body. We have been greatly relieved at this.

sa: सूर्ये चास्तमनुप्राप्ते तमसा चाभिसंवृते। नाज्ञायत तदा शत्रुर्न सुहन च कश्चन॥
en: At the setting of the sun at that moment, and at the enveloping of the earth with dusk, neither foe nor friend could be distinguished any longer.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा व्यथिता कुन्ती पुत्रैः सह यशस्विनी। नावमारुह्य गङ्गायां प्रययौ भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, having heard this, Kunti became deeply grieved. She then with her sons got into the boat and went over the Ganges.

sa: तौ राजपुत्रौ कात्स्न्येन धर्नामाख्यानमुत्तमम्। वाचोविधेयं तत्सर्वं कृत्वा काव्यमनिन्दितौ ॥ ऋषीणां च द्विजातीनां साधूनां च समागमे। यथोपदेशं तत्त्वज्ञौ जगतुः सुसमाहितौ ॥
en: Even as the reflection of the solar or the lunar disc resembles that disc; got by heart that excellent and moral story in its entirety; and those princes versed in the Fine arts, with a concentrated mind chanted it as they had learnt it, in the assemblies of ascetics and Brāhmaṇas and good men.

sa: दुर्योधनः कुलाङ्गारः शिष्टस्त्वं चास्य मातुलः॥ अद्य ते निहनष्यामि क्षुरेणोन्मथितं शिरः।
en: All those wicked men, that had ridiculed us then, have died. Only that vile wretch of his family viz., Duryodhana still and you his maternal uncle survive.

sa: उपसृत्य तु राजानं गदामोक्षविशारदः॥ आविध्यत गदां राजन् समुद्दिश्य सुतं तव।
en: Approaching the Kuru king, the son of Pandu, O king, an expert in the use of the mace, began to whirl his weapon, aiming at your son.

sa: कश्चिदाहूय तं संख्ये देशमन्यं प्रकर्षतु। तमजित्वा न कौन्तेयो निवर्तेत कथंचन॥
en: Let some one challenging him (Arjuna) in battle take him to another part of the field. The son of Kunti will not return without having vanquished him.

sa: केशिन्युवाच योऽसावयोध्यां प्रथमं गतोऽसौ ब्राह्मणस्तदा। इमानि नारीवाक्यानि कथयानः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Keshini said : The Brahmana, who had first gone to the city of Ayodhya, uttered again and again these expressions, suitable to the lips of a female:

sa: संतिष्ठस्व महाबाहो मुहूर्तमपि भारत। त्वयि तिष्ठति कौरव्य यातनास्मान् न बाधते॥
en: Do you remain here, O Bharata, for even a short time! As long as you are here O you of Kuru's race, tortures cease to afflict us.

sa: उत्तरस्य हिरण्यस्य परिवापश्च गालव। मार्गः पश्चिमपूर्वाभ्यां दिग्भ्यां वै मध्यमः स्मृतः॥
en: And since the north, which is the region of gold (and other treasures) stretches between the west and the east therefore is it called the central region.

sa: धर्मादिन्द्राच्च वाताच्च सुषुवे या सुतानिमान्। सेयं भूमौ परिश्रान्ता शेते प्रासादशायिनी॥
en: She, who has given birth to these sons by Dharma, Indra, Maruta; and who has ever slept in palaces, is now asleep on the ground from fatigue!

sa: यथा दृष्टश्च ते शक्रो भगवान् वा पिनाकधृक्। यथैवास्त्राण्यवाप्तानि यथैवाराधितश्च ते॥
en: How did you see the divine Sakra and the wielder of the Pinaka (Shiva) and how did you obtain the weapons and how did you worship (them),

sa: दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं तु दाशार्हमर्जुनार्थे व्यवस्थितम्। शिनीनामृषभं चैव मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः॥
en: Meseems, beholding Krishna of the Dasarha race and that foremost of the Sinis, both exerting for the sake of Arjuna, my sons are giving way to grief.

sa: प्रत्याख्याय च मां भीरु वशगं प्रियवादिनम्। नूनं त्वमसितापाङ्गि पश्चात्तापं करिष्यसि॥
en: O timid one, having disregarded me speaking so sweet to you and totally under your influence, surely, O black eyed one, you will have to true afterwards.

sa: राज्ञे च प्रेषयामासुर्यथावृत्तं निवेदितुम्। संवृत्तस्ते महान् कामः पाण्डवान् दग्धवानसि॥ सकामो भव कौरव्य भुड्क्ष्व राज्यं सपुत्रकः। तच्छ्रुत्वा धृतराष्ट्रस्तु सह पुत्रेण शोचयन्॥
en: They sent messenger to the king to tell him all that had happened and they said, “Your great end has been achieved, you have burnt to death the Pandavas. O descendant of Kuru, your desire is (now) fulfilled; enjoy the kingdom with your sons." Having heard this, Dhritarashtra with his sons expressed their sorrow.

sa: ततः स लङ्कापुरपर्वताग्रे समुत्थितो भीमपराक्रमोऽग्निः। प्रसार्य चूडावलयं प्रदीप्तो हनूमता वेगवतोपसृष्टः॥
en: And rising to the brow of Lanka's mount, (Trikūţa on which Lankā rested) the fire of terrific energy kindled by the impetuous Hanumān, spread wide his tongues.

sa: स्तम्भान् कनकचित्रांश्च तोरणानि बृहन्ति च। यज्ञायतनदेशेषु दत्त्वा शुद्धं च काननम्॥
en: Columns were raised, ornamented with bright gold an high and wide triumphal arches also were made on that sacrificial compound. All these were made of pure gold.

sa: तथैव विदुरं ब्रूयाः कुरूणां मन्त्रधारिणम्। अयुद्धं सौम्य भाषस्व हितकामो युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: In the same way should you thus speak to Vidura, the adviser of the Kurus, "O you peaceful one, advice peace, O you well wisher of Yudhishthira."

sa: ईर्ष्या मोदोऽतिवादश्च संज्ञानाशोऽभ्यसूयिता। तस्मात् प्राज्ञो न माद्येत सदा ह्येतद् विगर्हितम्॥
en: Envy, ignorance, excessive speech, loss of the senses and the desire to harm others. Therefore should a wise man never yield to Mada. It is ever reprehensible.

sa: तत्र हर्षकरी वाचो नराणां शुश्रुवेऽर्जुनः॥ दिष्ट्यासि पार्थकुशली धन्यो राजा युधिष्ठिरः।
en: And as Arjuna advanced, he heard many pleasing words uttered by the citizens. By good luck, O Partha, you are out of danger. Praise to king Yudhishthira.

sa: एष वृष्णिवरो वीरः सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। ग्रस्यते युधि वीरेण भानुमानिव राहुणा॥
en: "This foremost of the Vrishnis this hero Satyaki of indomitable prowess, is about to be destroyed in battle by the heroic Drona, like the sun by Rahu.

sa: ततः किल महावीर्यो भीष्मः शान्तनवो नृपान्। अधिक्षिप्य महातेजास्तिस्रः कन्या जहारताः॥
en: Then did Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, endued with great heroism and energy overthrowing all those rulers of the earth, take away the three girls by force.

sa: प्रज्ञाचक्षुरचक्षुष्ट्वाद् धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः। राज्यं न प्राप्तवान् पूर्वं स कथं नृपतिर्भवेत्॥
en: (They said), "The king Dhritarashtra, though possessed of the eye of knowledge, did not obtain "le kingdom, because he was blind. How can he be king (now)?

sa: श्यामा पद्मपलाशाक्षी प्रिया विरहिता मया। कथं धारयति प्राणान् विवशा जनकात्मजा॥
en: How has that exquisitely fine daughter of Janaka, my beloved spouse, having eyes resembling lotus-petals, brought under the control of another person, been living forsaken by me?

sa: तवाज्ञां शिरसा गृह्य पाण्डवार्थमहं प्रभो। भित्त्वेदं दुर्भिदं सैन्यं प्रयास्ये परपुङ्गव॥
en: Holding your behest on my head, I will, O lord, proceed piercing this impenetrable army, for rendering help, O best of men, to that son of Pandu.

sa: नाहं राजा भवान् राजा भवतः परवानहम्। कथं गुरुं त्वां धर्मज्ञमनुज्ञातुमिहोत्सहे॥
en: I am not the king. You are the king. I am dependent on your will. How can I dare grant permission to you who are my preceptor?

sa: महेन्द्र इव लक्ष्मीवानास्ते परमपूजितः। कस्येदानी विकारोऽयं य इमे नरकं गताः॥
en: Gifted with prosperity like that of the great Indra himself, he is reverently worshipped. What is that deed for which these (high-souled ones) have fallen into Hell?

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा विद्रुतान् सर्वान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् पराङ्मुखान्। जवेनाभ्यापतद् भीमः किरशरशतान् बहून्॥
en: Observing the whole hosts of the Dhritarasthra force thus dispersing themselves in every direction, Bhima, with great impetuosity rushed against them and attacked them with innumerable arrows.

sa: केकयानां शतं हत्वा विद्राव्य च समन्ततः। द्रोणस्तस्थौ महाराज व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः॥
en: Slaying a hundred warriors from the Kekaya hosts and routing them completely, Drona stood on the field, O king, like the Destroyer with his mouth wide open.

sa: श्रुत्वा ते वचनं सर्वे समायान्ति द्विजातयः॥ सर्वदेशेषु चागच्छन् वर्जयित्वा महोदयम्।
en: Hearing your message, the regenerate ones resident in every part will come here, and some have already arrived, all save Mahodaya and the hundred sons of Vasiştha.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ पुरुषव्याघ्र क्रियतामुदकं पितुः। अहं चायं च शत्रुघ्नः पूर्वमेव कृतोदकौ॥
en: O foremost of men, do you arise, and offer water to the spirit of our sire. Śatrughna and I have ere this offered water to (the departed).

sa: बुद्धिमान् मधुराभाषी पूर्वभाषी प्रियंवदः। वीर्यवान्न च वीर्येण महता स्वेन विस्मितः॥
en: He was intelligent, and sweet-speeched, and spoke first (to visitors) and used grateful words, and was possessed of prowess, withal not proud of his mighty native virtue.

sa: द्विजातीन् हि पदातीस्तान् रामश्चारित्रवत्सलः। न शशाक घृणाचक्षुः परिमोक्तुं रथेन सः॥
en: Endowed with kindness, that friend of the good, Rāma, could not by proceeding on his car bear to pare with the Brāhmaṇas that were following on foot.

sa: दर्शनं चित्रकूटस्य मन्दाकिन्याश्च शोभने। अधिकं पुरवासाच्च मन्ये तव च दर्शनात्॥
en: Methinks, O beauteous one, the sight of Citrakuta and of Mandakini is even more delightful than life in the metropolis, or the sight of your own self.

sa: वैदेहराजन्यसुता स्नुषा दशरथस्य च। रामपत्नी कथं दुःखं सम्प्राप्ता विजने वने॥
en: The daughter of Videha's King, and the daughter-in-law of Dasaratha, and the wife of Rāma himself, why does such a lady undergo misery in the lone forest?

sa: एवमुक्तास्ततः सैन्यास्तत्र तस्थुः समन्ततः। भरतो यत्र धूमाग्रं तत्र दृष्टिं समादधत्॥
en: Thus desired, the troops remained all about that place. Bharata went away, keeping his gaze fixed in the direction of the top of the column of) smoke.

sa: त्वं तु संक्लिष्टधर्मश्च कर्मणा च विगर्हितः। कामतन्त्रप्रधानश्च न स्थितो राजवर्त्मनि॥
en: You have oppressed virtue and perpetrated a gross iniquity. You have placed yourself under the control of your passions and deviated from the track of royal duties.

sa: आत्मानमनुतिष्ठ त्वं स्वभावेन नरर्षभ। निशाम्य तु शुभं वृत्तं पितुर्दशरथस्य नः॥
en: O best of men, thinking that our father Dasaratha has attained excellent state, do you, resorting to all noble qualities, seek your welfare in the next world.

sa: सालास्तालास्तमालांश्च पुंनागान्वञ्जुलान्धवान्॥ चम्पकान् नागवृक्षांश्च कर्णिकारांश्च पुष्पितान्। स्तबकैः काञ्चनैश्चित्र रक्तैः किसलयैस्तथा॥ आपीडैश्च लताभिश्च हेमाभरणभूषितान्। तरुणाादित्यसंकाशान् वैदूर्यमयवेदिकान्॥ विभ्राजमानान् वपुषा पादपांश्च हिरण्मयान्। नीलवैदूर्यवर्णाश्च पद्मिनी: पतगैर्वृताः॥ महद्भिः काञ्चनैर्वृक्षवृतं बालार्कसंनिभैः। जातरूपमयैर्मत्स्यैर्महद्भिश्चाथ पङ्कजैः॥ नलिनीस्तत्र ददृशुः प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः।
en: And Sālas and palms, and Tamālas, Punnāgas, Vañjulas, and Dhavās, Campakas, Nāga trees, Karņikāras in flower, with variegated golden bunches and twigs, and crests of clusters, and plants,-embellished with golden garniture; resembling the infantine sun,-on daises composed of lapises;—golden trees with resplendent bodies, having the hues of purple lapises; and lotus-plants flocked with fowls; and (spots) surrounded by large golden trees, like to the infantine sun; and tanks with large fishes or gold and lotuses, containing pleasant waters-all these saw there.

sa: स सम्प्रतस्थे धर्मात्मा प्रीतो दशरथात्मजः। वृतो महत्या नादिन्या सेनया चतुरङ्गया॥
en: And that virtuous son of Dasaratha with a glad heart held on this way, surrounded by that vast army consisting of fourfold forces, raising a tremendous uproar.

sa: शतं क्रतूनामाहृत्य देवराट् त्रिदिवं गतः। तपांस्युग्राणि चास्थाय दिवं प्राप्ता महर्षयः॥
en: Having acquired the appellation of Satakratu, the sovereign of the celestials has gone to heaven; and, having performed rigid austerities, the Maharșis have attained the celestial regions.'

sa: शत्रुघ्नोत्तिष्ठ किं शेषे निषादाधिपतिं गुहम्। शीघ्रमानय भद्रं ते तारयिष्यति वाहिनीम्॥
en: O Śatrughna, arise! Why sleepest you? Bring you at once that lord of the Nisādhas, Guha, Good betide you! he will take the army (over the stream.)

sa: हत्वेव ब्राह्मणं कामात् स्पृष्ट्वाग्निमिव पाणिना। अन्वतप्यत धर्मात्मा पुत्रं संचिन्त्य राघवम्॥
en: The righteous one remembering Rāghava repented himself, as if he had slain a Brāhmaṇa through inordinate desire, or as if he had placed his hand in fire.

sa: सर्वमेतद् विचेतव्यं यन्मया परिकीर्तितम्। यदन्यदपि नोक्तं च तत्रापि क्रियतां मतिः॥
en: You should search all these which I have described (to you); and you should also turn your attention to others besides, which I have omitted to mention.

sa: कः क्षत्रियकुले जातः श्रुतवान् नष्टसंशयः। धर्मलिङ्गप्रतिच्छन्नः क्रूरं कर्म समाचरेत् ॥
en: Who, born in the race of Kșatriyas, versed in religious lore, having his doubts removed and marks of piety on his person, perpetrates such an iniquitous deed?

sa: प्रायश्चित्तं महद्येतनरं वा पुरुषर्षभ। आनयस्व पशुं शीघ्रं यावत् कर्म प्रवर्तते॥
en: O best of men, even this is the expiation: do you, while the ceremony lasts, speedily bring back the beast, or bring a man in its stead.

sa: करिष्ये सर्वमेवाहमार्या यदनुशास्ति माम्। अभिज्ञास्मि यथा. भर्तुर्वर्तितव्यं श्रुतं च मे॥
en: I will do all that the noble one says. I know how I should act by my husband. I have heard all about that (from my parents.)

sa: भर्ता चैव सखा चैव रामो दाशरथिर्मम। तस्यार्थकामाः संनद्धा गङ्गानूपेऽत्र तिष्ठत॥
en: Rāma the son of Daśaratha is both my maintainer and friend. Do you in his interests, donning on your mail, wait on the banks of the river.

sa: निस्तुलाभिश्च मुक्ताभिर्मणिभिश्च महाधनैः॥ उद्धृतपुलिनास्तत्र जातरूपैश्च निम्नगाः। सर्वरत्नमयैश्चिौरवगाढा नगोत्तमैः॥ जातरूपमयैश्चापि हुताशनसमप्रभैः।
en: And the rivers there have islets covered with gold; and are crowded with lovely hills of gold, bright as fire, furnished with all kinds of precious stones.

sa: मम दर्शय सुग्रीव वैरिणं भ्रातृरूपिणम्॥ वाली विनिहतो यावद्वने पांसुषु चेष्टते।
en: Do you show me, O Sugriva, your enemy, in the guise of a brother. Wounded (by my shaft) Vāli shall roll in the dust in the forest.
